Conclusion: 通过解耦观察与行动并引入全景 observer 与 Observer Sink，World Observer 有效解决了 actor 中心世界模型中视野外状态与动力学丢失的问题；同时提出面向世界空间的评价指标与涵盖真实及合成场景的 benchmark。

Abstract: How can a world model continuously observe regions beyond the actor's current view? Video world models simulate how an environment evolves from an agent's actions, yet remain actor-centric. Once an object leaves the actor's view, they lose direct evidence of its evolution, often failing to preserve its state and dynamics upon re-entry. To address this, we introduce World Observer, which decouples observing from acting by jointly generating a perspective actor for the agent-centric view with one or more panoramic observers that watch selected world regions. This allows objects that leave the actor's view to remain visually evolving in an observer, so their updated states are reflected when they re-enter. We ground the actor and observers by warping from a shared panoramic source for explicit geometric correspondence, and introduce an Observer Sink of high-resolution perspective references to restore fine appearance upon re-entry. Since the observers are decoupled from the actor, they can be placed freely across the scene, extended to multiple locations for broader coverage, and driven by control signals to steer out-of-view evolution. To evaluate out-of-view evolution, we further introduce world-space metrics and a benchmark spanning real and synthetic scenes. World Observer substantially improves out-of-view dynamics while remaining competitive in visual fidelity, camera control, and 3D adherence.

</details>


### [165] [Generative Cinematographer: Composing Camera and Object Motion in 3D](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02180)
*Jiahan Zhang,Chaohao Yang,Namitha Guruprasad,Vivekjyoti Banerjee,Trong-Tung Nguyen,Alan Yuille,Anand Bhattad*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GenCine系统通过将单张图像提升为可编辑的3D场景支架，让艺术家在统一世界坐标系下联合编辑相机路径与前景物体运动，并将这些3D控制投影为引导图，训练轻量分支与LoRA适配器驱动预训练视频模型，实现相机相对运动与视角变化下的几何一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可控视频生成依赖2D运动轨迹或稀疏拖拽信号，存在运动歧义：同一2D轨迹可对应不同3D运动，尤其在相机与物体同时运动时。缺乏在3D层级联合控制相机与物体运动、且不依赖物理模拟器或类别先验的手段。

Method: 将单张图像提升为可编辑3D场景支架；艺术家指定相机路径并用局部3D运动手柄移动选定前景区域，多个手柄对主体不同部位独立控制，构成对非刚性运动的分片刚体近似。将控制投影为引导图：记录受控区域每帧位置、为每个手柄分配固定颜色，并在与背景相同的世界坐标系中编码受控点的3D位置，从而表达相对场景的物体运动。训练时从真实视频运动恢复控制，并利用合成视频的真值几何与轨迹；在预训练Wan模型上训练轻量引导分支与LoRA适配器。

Result: 实验显示相机相对运动一致、视角变化下几何一致性提升，并在多样真实场景中具备强可控性。

Conclusion: 通过3D场景支架与引导图将显式3D相机与物体运动控制注入预训练视频模型，可有效缓解2D控制歧义，实现相机相对一致的几何可控视频生成。

Abstract: Current controllable video generation systems often rely on 2D motion trajectories or sparse drag signals for object motion. These controls are ambiguous because the same 2D trajectory can correspond to different 3D motions, especially when the camera and objects move simultaneously. We present Generative Cinematographer (GenCine), a system that lifts a single image into an editable 3D scene scaffold where artists jointly author camera and foreground motion. Artists specify a camera path and move selected foreground regions using local 3D motion handles. Several handles can move different parts of a subject independently, providing a piecewise-rigid approximation to non-rigid motion without a physics simulator or category-specific prior. To communicate these controls to a pretrained video model, we project them into guidance maps. These maps record where the controlled regions appear in each frame, assign each handle a fixed color across frames and encode the current 3D positions of its controlled points in the same world coordinate system as the background. This lets us describe object motion relative to the scene even as the camera moves. For training, we recover controls from the motion observed in real videos and use ground-truth geometry and trajectories from synthetic videos. We train a lightweight guidance branch and LoRA adapters on a pretrained Wan model to follow these controls. Our experiments show consistent camera-relative motion, improved geometric consistency under viewpoint changes, and strong controllability across diverse real-world scenes.

</details>


### [166] [OmniSeek: Native Tool Integration for Multi-turn Audio-Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02181)
*Haibo Wang,Jiteng Mu,Jialu Li,Jingru Yi,Yuanjun Xiong,Jianming Zhang,Lifu Huang,Mingze Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OmniSeek 是一个将全模态大模型改造为具备原生工具调用能力的主动式多轮推理智能体的框架，通过"证据获取即推理"的范式，在长上下文中动态选择看或听、确定时间窗口，并结合数据合成与两阶段强化学习实现跨模态自适应证据搜索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全模态大模型通常以单次前向传播被动处理完整音视频序列，难以在长上下文中定位稀疏但关键的跨模态证据，且易依赖单一模态捷径而忽略真正的音视频协同推理需求。

Method: 提出 OmniSeek：让模型动态决定是否看或听及时间窗口，以检索稀疏关键证据；通过迭代多轮协议将检索到的原始音频/视觉片段回填上下文以支持后续推理。构建数据引擎合成 OmniTraj-170K（含交错音视觉证据的多跳思维链轨迹），先做监督微调注入多轮工具使用行为，再用带可验证奖励的两阶段强化学习优化策略；同时引入 Audio-Visual Necessity 目标，奖励真正依赖双模态的成功轨迹以抑制单模态捷径。

Result: 在广泛的基准测试上，OmniSeek 学习到自适应的跨模态证据搜索能力，并一致性地提升了音视频推理性能。

Conclusion: 将证据获取纳入推理过程并结合多跳轨迹监督与可验证奖励强化学习，可有效激发全模态大模型的主动跨模态推理能力，Audio-Visual Necessity 目标有助于避免单模态捷径，为长上下文音视频推理提供了可行范式。

Abstract: We present OmniSeek, an agentic framework that transforms an Omni Large Language Model (Omni-LLM) into an active, multi-turn reasoning agent with native tool use. Rather than passively processing an entire audio-visual sequence in a single forward pass, OmniSeek makes evidence acquisition part of the reasoning process: it dynamically decides whether to look or listen, and over which temporal window, to retrieve sparse but critical evidence across different modalities within long contexts. Through an iterative multi-turn protocol, the retrieved raw audio or visual segments are appended back into the context to support subsequent reasoning. To cold-start this capability, we build a data engine that synthesizes OmniTraj-170K, a corpus of multi-hop Chain-of-Thought trajectories with interleaved audio and visual evidence. We first supervise the model on these trajectories to instill multi-turn tool-use behavior, and then further optimize the policy via a two-stage reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. Moreover, we introduce an Audio-Visual Necessity objective that explicitly rewards successful trajectories whose reasoning depends on both modalities, discouraging single-modality shortcuts. Extensive experiments across a wide range of benchmarks demonstrate that OmniSeek learns adaptive cross-modal evidence seeking and consistently improves audio-visual reasoning performance.

</details>


### [167] [DMAD: Distribution Matching as Adversarial Distillation for Fast Visual Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02188)
*Zhengming Yu,Junkun Yuan,Haotian Yang,Gordon Guocheng Qian,Yizhi Wang,Angtian Wang,Yiding Yang,Bo Liu,Xin Li,Wenping Wang,Chongyang Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DMAD将分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）重构为分类问题，用共享骨干上的两个判别头直接学习对数密度比，无需额外拟合辅助扩散模型，在图像与视频少步生成上取得领先效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DMD通过分别估计目标得分与学生得分之差来训练少步学生模型，因此必须维护一个拟合学生演化分布的辅助扩散模型，带来额外的显存与计算开销。作者希望去除这一辅助得分拟合环节，降低开销。

Method: 提出DMAD（Distribution Matching as Adversarial Distillation），把分布匹配重构为分类：在共享骨干上设置两个判别头，分别区分真实数据、教师样本与学生样本，并直接对判别器logits施加线性损失来训练学生，而不做辅助得分拟合。理论上证明在判别器最优处，这些损失可恢复DMD所依据的分布匹配梯度，其依据是判别器logits与对数密度比之间的经典恒等式。此外提出基于gap的加权策略，利用真实数据头在真假样本间经验logit gap来自适应调整各噪声水平下的教师监督强度。

Result: 在ImageNet-64x64上单步生成FID为1.04；在COCO-10K上四步SDXL的FID为14.47；四步Wan2.1-T2V-14B的VBench总分达85.15，均为所比较的少步方法和多步教师中的最佳值。在MiniMax-H3-33B上，四步学生在联合音视频生成中相对DMD2的人类偏好率为79.1%、相对rCM为84.6%（不计平局）。

Conclusion: DMAD通过分类式的判别框架直接学习对数密度比，避免了DMD的辅助扩散模型开销，同时理论上有据、实验上在多模态少步生成任务中达到或超越现有方法。

Abstract: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) trains a few-step student from the difference between separately estimated target and student scores, so it must keep an auxiliary diffusion model fitted to the student's evolving distribution at extra memory and computation cost. We introduce DMAD, Distribution Matching as Adversarial Distillation, which recasts distribution matching as classification and learns the required log-density ratios directly. Two discriminator heads on a shared backbone distinguish real data and teacher samples from the student's, and linear losses on their logits train the student without auxiliary score fitting. We prove that at the discriminator optimum these losses recover the distribution-matching gradient underlying DMD, through the classical identity linking discriminator logits to log-density ratios. We further introduce gap-based reweighting, which adapts teacher supervision across noise levels from the real-data head's empirical logit gap between real and teacher samples. DMAD reaches a Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) of 1.04 with one-step generation on ImageNet-64x64, 14.47 with four-step SDXL on COCO-10K, and a VBench total score of 85.15 with four-step Wan2.1-T2V-14B, the best values among the compared few-step methods and the multi-step teachers. On MiniMax-H3-33B, our four-step student achieves overall human preference rates of 79.1% over DMD2 and 84.6% over rCM for joint audio-video generation, excluding ties. Our code, models and demos are available at https://yzmblog.github.io/projects/DMAD.

</details>


### [168] [HiPhy: Hierarchical Alignment for Physically-Plausible Multi-Principle Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02197)
*Tahira Kazimi,Shubhankar Borse,Munawar Hayat,Fatih Porikli,Pinar Yanardag*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HiPhy：一种双层级强化学习对齐框架，将视频生成锚定于物理定律，支持多物理原理同时在场景中协调展开。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型视觉保真度高，但难以遵循物理定律；尤其在真实场景中多个物理原理需同时协调作用（如气球上浮与蒸汽上升同时发生的浮力与流体动力学）时问题更突出。已有方法多聚焦单一物理原理，忽视多原理交互。

Method: 提出 HiPhy（Hierarchical Physical Alignment）强化学习框架，采用双层级目标：局部层面约束单个物理原理的时间动力学，全局层面确保整个场景的物理与语义一致性。同时构建 50K 提示词数据集，并提出多物理事件基准 MultiPhyBench。

Result: HiPhy 在多个基准上显著优于以往方法与基线，物理常识与语义对齐均有明显提升；在多个物理原理同时发生的场景中增益最大，而竞争方法在此类场景下降最严重。

Conclusion: 通过双层级强化学习对齐，HiPhy 有效缓解视频生成中的多物理原理协调难题，为通用世界模拟器方向提供可行路径。

Abstract: Video generation models have achieved remarkable visual fidelity and have strong potential to become general-purpose world simulators. Despite this progress, they still fail to generate videos which adhere to laws of physics. The problem becomes even more apparent in realistic settings where multiple physical principles must work together within the same video; for example, "a balloon floating upward while steam rises from a pot" requires buoyancy and fluid dynamics to unfold coherently and simultaneously. Yet existing methods largely ignore multi-principle interactions, focusing on a single principle per video. We propose HiPhy (Hierarchical Physical Alignment), a reinforcement learning framework that grounds video generation in physical laws through a dual-level objective: locally enforcing the temporal dynamics of individual physical principles, and globally ensuring the physical and semantic coherence of the entire scene. To support multi-principle generation, we construct a 50K-prompt dataset and introduce a prompt benchmark MultiPhyBench, spanning a diverse range of co-occurring physical events. Our experiments show that HiPhy significantly outperforms prior methods and baselines, improving physical commonsense and semantic alignment significantly across various benchmarks, with the largest gains on scenes involving multiple concurrent physical principles where competing methods degrade most sharply.

</details>


### [169] [SILSA: Sliding-Window Slice Latents for Topology-Preserving High-Resolution 3D Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02201)
*Tianjiao Yu,Xinzhuo Li,Yifan Shen,Ying Shen,Kiet A. Nguyen,Adheesh Sunil Juvekar,Ismini Lourentzou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SILSA：用多轴重叠滑窗切片潜变量表示3D形状，单阶段生成并配以切片级拓扑监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高分辨率3D生成依赖体素潜变量与"先预测结构、再合成局部几何"的多阶段流水线，导致连续表面被切碎为大量局部token，生成开销高，且薄结构或高连通形状的拓扑一致性较弱。

Method: 沿三条规范轴使用固定数量的重叠切片，每个token概括局部深度窗口，保留截面连续性并支持单阶段rectified-flow生成；Slice VAE将定向表面采样编码为多轴切片潜变量，并用稀疏体解码器重建；体素锚格（Volumetric Anchor Lattice）在共享3D工作空间协调各方向切片流；引入切片级拓扑监督，匹配持久图（persistence diagrams）并对齐相邻切片的Betti转变。

Result: 相较最强基线，PSNR提升8.7%，coverage提升5.96个绝对点，Betti误差降低9.2%；token数比次紧凑基线少70.0%，比稀疏/层次化tokenizer少98%以上；训练内存降低40.4%，推理时间降低58.5%。定性结果显示薄结构、重复部件与长程连通性保持更好。

Conclusion: 以紧凑滑窗切片潜变量替代体素token，可在单阶段生成框架下同时提升结构保真度与拓扑一致性，并大幅降低生成成本。

Abstract: High-resolution 3D generation increasingly relies on voxel latents and multi-stage pipelines that first predict active structure and then synthesize local geometry. While effective, this design fragments continuous surfaces into many local tokens, inflates generation cost, and often weakens topological consistency for thin or highly connected shapes. We introduce SILSA, a topology-aware 3D generation framework that represents shapes with compact sliding-window slice latents. Instead of generating expensive voxel tokens, SILSA uses a fixed set of overlapping slices along the three canonical axes, where each token summarizes a local depth window to preserve cross-sectional continuity and support single-stage rectified-flow generation. A Slice VAE encodes oriented surface samples into multi-axis slice latents and reconstructs them with a sparse volumetric decoder, while a Volumetric Anchor Lattice coordinates directional slice streams through a shared 3D workspace. To preserve structural correctness, we introduce slice-level topology supervision that matches persistence diagrams and aligns Betti transitions across neighboring slices. Experiments show that SILSA improves structural fidelity while substantially reducing generation cost. SILSA improves PSNR by $8.7\%$, coverage by $5.96$ absolute points, and Betti error by $9.2\%$ over the strongest baseline, while using $70.0\%$ fewer tokens than the next-most compact baseline and over $98\%$ fewer tokens than sparse or hierarchical tokenizers, effectively reducing training memory by $40.4\%$ and inference time by $58.5\%$. Qualitative results further show improved preservation of thin structures, repeated components, and long-range connectivity.

</details>


### [170] [Embedding Prediction Helps Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02203)
*Sihan Xu,Ji Xie,Zilin Wang,Hui Shen,Stella X. Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出NEPA：用预测的连续嵌入代替固定类别/文本条件，在每个去噪步重算条件，NEPA-DiT-XL在ImageNet 256×256上达到FID 1.32，仅用REPA约三分之一的训练算力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散Transformer中类别标签或文本提示只嵌入一次并在所有去噪步重复使用，条件信号无法随当前噪声状态自适应变化。作者追问：能否用预测出的嵌入来充当该条件。

Method: NEPA训练Transformer自回归预测序列中下一个连续嵌入；生成时干净图像位于噪声图像之后，其嵌入即条件与噪声图像之后的下一个嵌入。通过Multi-Embedding Prediction一次性预测全部嵌入；在Embedding Conditioned Generation中，DiT生成器以这些预测为条件，并在每个去噪步重新计算，使条件信号适应当前噪声状态。

Result: 在类别条件ImageNet 256×256上研究了生成器条件、Multi-Embedding Prediction设计及两个模型的缩放。NEPA模型为每个采样步额外增加一个网络；结合REPA后，最终模型NEPA-DiT-XL取得FID 1.32，训练算力约为REPA的三分之一。

Conclusion: 预测嵌入可作为扩散Transformer的动态条件，替代一次性静态条件；逐去噪步重算条件能显著提升生成质量与训练效率。

Abstract: In diffusion transformers, a class label or a text prompt is embedded once, and the same condition is reused at every denoising step. We ask whether predicted embeddings can serve as this condition instead. Next-Embedding Predictive Autoregression (NEPA) trains a Transformer to predict the next continuous embedding in a sequence. In generation, the clean image follows the noisy image, so its embeddings are the next embeddings after the condition and the noisy image. We train a NEPA model to predict them all at once with Multi-Embedding Prediction, and in Embedding Conditioned Generation, a DiT generator is conditioned on these predictions, recomputed at every denoising step, so the conditioning signal adapts to the current noisy state. Experiments on class-conditional ImageNet $256\times256$ study the condition of the generator, the design of Multi-Embedding Prediction, and the scaling of both models. The NEPA model adds a second network to every sampling step; with it, and combined with REPA, our final model, NEPA-DiT-XL, reaches an FID of 1.32 using about a third of the training compute of REPA.

</details>


### [171] [ROWBench: Do Video Models Render What the Program Specifies?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02205)
*Zheng-Hui Huang,Guixu Lin,Yu-Ju Tsai,Jian-Kai Zhu,Fengbo Lan,Yu-Lun Liu,Yung-Yu Chuang,Kaipeng Zhang,Zhixiang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PROWBench，一个用于评估程序化世界模型视觉保真度的基准，包含170个程序化构建的片段和600个代理视频，通过可回放的世界记录来检验生成视频是否忠实呈现程序指定的事件与交互。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 程序化世界模型将可执行动力学与视觉生成分离，但其对显式规则与交互的视觉遵循程度缺乏充分评估。现有基准多关注视觉质量、可控性及指令或物理遵循，很少测试对细粒度、程序指定的世界事件的保真度。

Method: 构建PROWBench基准：包含170个程序化片段与600个代理视频，覆盖多样场景与交互；记录实体状态与带时间戳事件（含视野外事件），形成可回放世界记录，并据此渲染同步视图与代理表示。提供可扩展框架用于构建场景、控制行为，并以不同表示（如粗粒度3D、边界框）渲染各相机视图。评测涵盖第一与第三人称视角，部分片段提供同步多视角观测；评估实体控制、长时程记忆，以及两项基于VLM的指标——逻辑-渲染对齐度与交互成功率。

Result: PROWBench可支持对生成视频的检验，使其对照程序执行的可观测结果进行评估，覆盖实体控制、长时程记忆及时间线遵循与视觉实现情况，并利用两项VLM指标量化逻辑-渲染对齐与交互成功。

Conclusion: PROWBench填补了程序化世界模型在细粒度程序指定事件视觉保真度评估方面的空白，为下一代游戏引擎相关模型提供了更贴近执行逻辑与交互的评测基础。

Abstract: Programmable world models separate executable dynamics from visual generation, offering a promising foundation for next-generation game engines. However, their visual adherence to explicit rules and interactions remains insufficiently evaluated. Existing benchmarks assess visual quality, controllability, and instruction or physical adherence, but rarely test fidelity to fine-grained, program-specified world events. We introduce PROWBench, comprising 170 programmatically constructed episodes and 600 proxy videos covering diverse scenes and interactions. PROWBench logs entity states and timestamped events, including those outside the camera's field of view, as replayable world records, from which it renders synchronized views and proxy representations. This enables generated videos to be checked against the observable consequences of program execution. An extensible framework constructs scenes, controls behaviors, and can render each camera view in different representations, such as coarse 3D, and bounding boxes. The benchmark covers first- and third-person perspectives, with synchronized multi-view observations available for a subset of episodes. Grounded in these records, PROWBench evaluates entity control, long-horizon memory, and, with two VLM-based metrics, Logic-Render Alignment and Interaction Success Rate, adherence to the prescribed timeline and the visual realization of timestamped engine-recorded events.

</details>


### [172] [One Basis to Animate Them All: Gaussian Blendshape Distillation for Real-Time Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02207)
*Ramazan Fazylov,Stamatis Lefkimmiatis,Ivan Laptev*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GALA蒸馏方法，用浅层系数预测器加线性混合近似预训练3D高斯Avatar的动画，将CPU动画开销降低最多三个数量级，移动端可达60fps。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D高斯Avatar渲染快，但实时动画受限于昂贵的神经推理成本，需要一种能保持渲染质量同时大幅降低动画开销的加速方案。

Method: 基于"预训练Avatar模型的动画可被身份无关的blendshape线性组合紧密近似"这一发现，用浅层系数预测器加线性混合替代逐帧的沉重神经解码；在渲染感知度量与内存预算下，用块局部PCA构造基；训练浅层MLP预测blendshape系数，无需重训原模型，可适配多种动画架构。

Result: 在三种不同Avatar模型（面部表情与带衣物动态的全身动画）上验证：蒸馏可泛化到未见身份，CPU动画开销降低最多三个数量级，同时保留大部分渲染质量，移动端帧率达60fps。

Conclusion: 结果证实了所学Avatar表示的共享线性结构，实现了高效且准确的动画，并为实时Avatar动画提供了通用、低成本的蒸馏加速范式。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian avatars support fast rendering, however, their real-time animation is often challenged by the costly neural inference. We address this bottleneck and show that the animation of pretrained avatar models can be closely approximated by a linear combination of identity-independent blendshapes. Building on this finding, we introduce GALA (Gaussian Animation via Linear Approximation), a distillation method that replaces per-frame heavy neural decoding with a shallow coefficient predictor and a linear blend. To improve fidelity and reduce memory requirements, we propose to construct the basis using block-local PCA under a rendering-aware metric and a memory budget. Our method learns a shallow MLP network to predict blendshape coefficients and applies to various animation architectures without retraining original models. We validate GALA by accelerating the inference of three distinct avatar models for 3D animation of facial expressions and full-bodies with clothing dynamics. Across these models, our distillation generalizes to held-out identities and reduces CPU animation cost by up to three orders of magnitude while preserving most of the rendering quality. Excellent results of our method confirm the shared linear structure of learned avatar representations and enable highly efficient and accurate animation at frame rates reaching up to 60fps on mobile devices. Project page: https://ramazan793.github.io/gala/

</details>


### [173] [Sphere Encoder 2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02208)
*Kaiyu Yue,Sean McLeish,Ruchit Rawal,Brian Bartoldson,Menglin Jia,Tom Goldstein*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Sphere Encoder 2，针对原版Sphere Encoder的两个局限——潜在球面上训练旋转未覆盖赤道附近区域导致单步生成空隙，以及像素级重建损失导致解码器平均化、生成图像模糊——进行改进，在保持自编码器速度与简洁性的同时显著提升图像生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原版Sphere Encoder通过从高维潜在球面解码随机点生成图像，但存在两个降低生成质量的问题：一是随机点相对极点集中在赤道附近，而训练旋转从未到达该区域，留下空隙，限制单步生成；二是使用像素级重建损失训练生成会导致解码器对多个合理图像取平均，生成模糊、缺乏高频细节的图像。因此需要新的方法解决这两点。

Method: 提出Sphere Encoder 2，针对上述两个局限进行改进（摘要未给出具体技术细节）。

Result: 在保持自编码器速度与简洁性的同时，显著提升了图像生成质量。模型已发布于 https://github.com/kaiyuyue/sphere2。

Conclusion: Sphere Encoder 2有效缓解了潜在球面训练旋转覆盖不足与像素级重建损失导致的模糊问题，实现了更优的图像生成质量，同时保留了自编码器的高效与简单特性。

Abstract: Sphere Encoder is an autoencoder that generates images by decoding random points from a high-dimensional latent sphere. We identify two limitations of the original formulation that reduce its generation quality. First, random points concentrate near the equator relative to the pole on an encoded latent, but the training rotation never reaches this region, leaving a gap that limits one-step generation. Second, training for generation with pixel-wise reconstruction loss encourages the decoder to average over plausible images, producing blurry images that lack high-frequency details. We present Sphere Encoder 2 to address both limitations, substantially improving image generation quality while maintaining the speed and simplicity of a autoencoder. Models are released at \href{https://github.com/kaiyuyue/sphere2}{github.com/kaiyuyue/sphere2}.

</details>


### [174] [Moore, Escher, Penrose: A Conformal Golden Braid](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02210)
*Sophia Feldman,Assaf Shocher*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出在扩散模型采样过程中"编织"图像变换 $T$ 及其广义逆 $T^\dagger$，让场景内容与几何扭曲协同演化，从而生成类《Print Gallery》的自指递归图像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受 Escher 石版画《Print Gallery》及其共形幂映射 $z \mapsto z^\alpha$ 数学分析的启发，希望借助冻结的文本到图像扩散模型生成新的自指场景。但仅靠 prompt 无法强制递归结构，后处理变换会破坏结构连通性，采样过程中施加变换又会被去噪器"修复"或漂移出既定几何，因此需要新的生成机制。

Method: 针对不可逆图像变换 $T$，构造适应其递归约束的广义逆 $T^\dagger$，使 Penrose 恒等式 $TT^\dagger T = T$ 成立、$TT^\dagger$ 成为到几何可容许图像上的幂等投影。鉴于只对变换后图像去噪仍属分布外任务，作者将去噪步骤与 $T$、$T^\dagger$ 交替编织：源空间步骤发展未扭曲场景，变换空间步骤则精修其在最终几何中的外观与连接。

Result: 成功生成了类《Print Gallery》的构图，并进一步探索了其他变换形式；相比对成品图像做扭曲或仅在采样中施加变换，该方法能保持结构的良好连接与几何一致性。

Conclusion: 与其扭曲一张已完成的图像，不如让场景与其扭曲共同成长；将变换及其广义逆交织进扩散采样过程，是生成自指递归几何图像的有效途径。

Abstract: I don't think I have ever done anything as peculiar in my life. Among other things, it shows a young man looking with interest at a print on the wall of an exhibition that features himself. How can this be? Perhaps I am not far removed from Einstein's curved universe.'' So wrote M.C. Escher about his 1956 lithograph Print Gallery. Nearly half a century later, a mathematical analysis related its geometry to an untwisted source image through a conformal power map $z \mapsto z^α$, $α\in \mathbb{C}$. Building on this construction, we use a frozen text-to-image diffusion model to generate new self-referential scenes. Prompting alone does not enforce the recursion, while a post-hoc transformation can leave structures poorly connected. Applying the transformation during sampling is also insufficient: the denoiser may "repair" the intended distortion or drift out of the prescribed geometry. We construct a generalized inverse $T^\dagger$ of the non-invertible image transformation $T$, adapted to its recursive constraint. In the idealized formulation, the Penrose identity $TT^\dagger T = T$ makes $TT^\dagger$ an idempotent projection onto geometrically admissible images. Yet denoising only the transformed image remains an out-of-distribution task, even with projection. We therefore braid denoising steps with $T$ and $T^\dagger$: source-space steps develop the untwisted scene, while transformed-space steps refine its appearance and connections in the final geometry. We generate Print Gallery-like compositions and explore further transformations. Rather than distorting a finished image, we let the scene and its distortion develop together.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [175] [On-Device Named-Entity Recognition: A Deployability Study of Accuracy, Cost, Reliability, and Confidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00007)
*Vinay Kumar Chaganti*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究系统对比了九种可本地部署的NER系统（spaCy、GLiNER、多个本地生成式LLM），在三个数据集上报告准确率、延迟与输出有效性；利用跨家族LLM评审团构建银标金标准并做人

工复验（严格F1 0.95），发现金标准来源会翻转范式排名；编码器模型以1/9–1/24的参数量、毫秒至秒级延迟和零格式错误实现可比性能，最小生成模型长文本下无效输出高达27%；并刻画GLiNER置信度（AUROC 0.76–0.86，ECE 0.24–0.47，温度缩放可减半）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端侧NER需求上升（无需API、低延迟、数据本地化），但实践者关心的不是排行榜名次，而是：哪个模型真正可部署、无人工标注如何评估、置信度是否可信。现有文献普遍忽略延迟与输出有效性这两个维度，也未系统回答上述三个问题。

Method: 在三个性质不同的数据集上评测九种系统，覆盖三种范式、13M–8B参数：经典标注器spaCy、双向编码器专才（GLiNER，166–460M）、本地运行的生成式LLM（Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B-Instruct、DeepSeek-R1-1.5B/8B）。报告准确率、延迟与输出有效性。因RSS-News语料无金标准，采用跨家族LLM评审团生成银标金标准，并在基准金标准与全语料人工复验下测量其保真度。此外对GLiNER的逐span置信度做校准分析（AUROC、ECE、温度缩放、阈值化、级联路由）。所有数值可由逐span记录离线复算。

Result: 银标金标准严格F1为0.95（因人工金标准以银标为种子，此为上限）；金标准来源会翻转范式排名——从LLM银标换为人工金标时，所有编码器上升、所有生成模型下降。单看准确率，4B instruct LLM具竞争力（在干净新闻专线上领先）。编码器的优势在于可部署性：在1/9–1/24参数规模下性能相当或略低，延迟为毫秒至秒级，且零格式错误；最小生成模型在长输入上无效输出率高达27%，该问题靠规模而非输出预算解决。GLiNER置信度排序能力良好（AUROC 0.76–0.86）但过度自信（ECE 0.24–0.47，温度缩放可减半）；阈值化带来小幅但诚实的样本外F1提升；全本地小到大级联相对等成本随机路由有适度且依赖语料的增益；置信度追踪正确性但不追踪新颖性。

Conclusion: 端侧NER的可部署性关键在于编码器：以极小参数规模、低延迟与零格式错误实现与4B级生成模型相当或略低的准确率；生成模型的有效输出问题需靠规模解决。无人工标注评估中，LLM评审团银标是可行但有偏的方案，金标准来源会实质性影响结论。置信度可用于排序与阈值决策，但需温度缩放并注意其不反映新颖性。全部结果可由逐span记录离线复现。

Abstract: Named-entity recognition (NER) is increasingly wanted on-device (no API, low latency, data kept local). The practitioner's question is not the leaderboard but which model is deployable, how to evaluate it without human annotation, and whether its confidence can be trusted. We answer these jointly. We place nine systems across three paradigms and 13 M to 8 B parameters: a classical tagger (spaCy), bidirectional-encoder specialists (GLiNER, 166 to 460 M), and generative LLMs run locally (Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B-Instruct, DeepSeek-R1-1.5B/8B), on three datasets of differing character, and report accuracy plus two axes the literature omits: latency and output validity. Because our corpus (RSS-News) had no gold, we built silver gold from a cross-family LLM judge panel, then measured its fidelity against benchmark gold and a full human re-validation of the corpus (strict F1 0.95, an upper bound since the human gold was silver-seeded); gold provenance flips the paradigm ranking, moving from LLM-authored silver to human gold raises every encoder and lowers every generative model. On accuracy alone a 4 B instruct LLM is competitive (it leads on clean newswire), so the encoder's case is deployability: it matches or slightly trails at one-ninth to one-twenty-fourth the size, at millisecond-to-second latency, with zero malformed output, while the smallest generative models emit up to 27% invalid output on long inputs, a failure fixed by scale, not output budget. We then characterize GLiNER's per-span confidence: it ranks correctness well (AUROC 0.76 to 0.86) but is overconfident (ECE 0.24 to 0.47, halved by temperature scaling); thresholding gives a small honest out-of-sample F1 gain; an all-local small-to-large cascade gives a modest, corpus-dependent gain over cost-matched random routing; and confidence tracks correctness but not novelty. Every number recomputes offline from per-span records.

</details>


### [176] [SCM-based Fairness and Faithful Explainability for Legal Document Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00045)
*Yasmina El Kacemi,Seyed Sahand Mohammadi Ziabari,Ali Mohammed Mansoor Alsahag*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在ECtHR数据集上，对LegalBERT施加温暖-能力刻板表征公平正则化，在性能最优强度下未改善人口统计公平性，却稳定降低SHAP解释充分性，揭示公平性与解释忠实度的解耦。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法律决策支持中的Transformer模型（如LegalBERT）同时面临公平性与解释透明性两方面关切，但二者通常被分开评估，尚不清楚去偏干预在改变公平性的同时是否会改变解释对模型推理的忠实反映。

Method: 基于LexGLUE的ECtHR指称违规语料，将LegalBERT基线与其公平正则化变体对比；该变体在微调时惩罚刻板化的温暖（warmth）与能力（competence）表征。评估涵盖预测性能、人口统计公平性与SHAP解释忠实度，跨5个随机种子；并设置两种公平定义、性别轴传统词对控制以及打乱词对控制。

Result: 在性能最优正则强度下，干预未降低人口统计差异，该零结果在两种公平定义与词对控制下均成立，分类性能基本不变；但干预在全部5个种子、3个阈值上一致地损害解释充分性。打乱词对控制复现了解释退化，而性能与公平性不变，表明该效应源于对比式表征正则化本身，而非特定的温暖-能力结构。

Conclusion: 公平性与解释忠实度之间存在解耦：解释行为的变化未必指示公平性的变化，因此公平性必须被直接评估，不能以解释指标作为其代理。

Abstract: Transformer models such as LegalBERT are increasingly used in legal decision support, raising concerns about both fairness and the transparency of model explanations. These properties are usually evaluated separately, leaving open whether a debiasing intervention that changes fairness also changes how faithfully explanations reflect model reasoning. This study investigates that relationship on the ECtHR alleged-violations corpus from LexGLUE. It compares a LegalBERT baseline with a fairness-regularized variant that penalizes stereotypical warmth and competence representations during fine-tuning. The evaluation covers predictive performance, demographic fairness, and SHAP explanation faithfulness across five random seeds. At the performance-optimal regularization strength, the intervention does not reduce demographic disparity. This null result holds across two fairness definitions and a conventional word-pair control on the gender axis. Classification performance is largely unchanged. However, the intervention consistently degrades explanation sufficiency across all five seeds and three thresholds. A shuffled-pair control reproduces this degradation while leaving performance and fairness unchanged, indicating that the effect arises from contrastive representational regularization rather than specifically from the warmth and competence structure. The results demonstrate a dissociation between fairness and explanation faithfulness: changes in explanation behavior do not necessarily indicate changes in fairness, and fairness must therefore be evaluated directly.

</details>


### [177] [The First Token Is Not the Verdict: Hidden Costs of Reading LLM Judges Without Generating](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00054)
*Gnaneswar Villuri,Hashmath Shaik,Alex Doboli*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 从LLM评判器首个生成token的logits读取裁决会单向高估位置偏差，该读数应被视为上界；建议同时报告"首token即裁决"的比例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从首个生成token的logits读取评判结果成本极低（无需生成），且正是约束解码与似然打分评测框架的产物，因而被广泛使用；但作者怀疑这种读法会系统性扭曲位置偏差。

Method: 对比"强制首token读数"与"生成后读数"：在多个评判器（三个Qwen3、Llama-3.1-8B、Phi-3.5-mini）与924个未在首token表态的样本对上，测量交换响应顺序后的翻转率，并分别量化对位置偏差与评判准确率的影响；另考察首token为裁决字母但推理出相反结论的情形。

Result: 未在首token表态的样本占比：Qwen3评判器为12%–49%，Llama-3.1-8B与Phi-3.5-mini低于3%。强制读数在交换顺序后于89.7%的样本上翻转，而生成后读数为47.5%（配对差+0.422，95% CI [+0.365, +0.467]）。该扭曲具有测量特异性：位置偏差变动达42个百分点，而准确率在10个条件中的7个变动不足1个百分点。此外，首token即表态时仍有0–5.5%的样本"先表态后反悔"，其比例与合规率不相关。

Conclusion: 首token logits读数系统性地高估位置偏差，属于上界而非无偏估计，主要误导评判器的审计者而非使用者；建议在报告任何位置偏差指标时，一并报告"首token即裁决"的比例——该指标仅需一次前向传播且无需标注。

Abstract: Reading an LLM judge's verdict from the logits of its first generated token is cheap, requires no generation, and is exactly what constrained decoding and likelihood-scoring evaluation harnesses produce. We show that this readout distorts position bias in one direction: it overstates it in every condition we test, so figures obtained this way behave as upper bounds. The mechanism is that judges do not always lead with a verdict token, on 12% to 49% of pairs for three Qwen3 judges and under 3% for Llama-3.1-8B and Phi-3.5-mini, and forcing a read on those pairs returns whichever response was shown first rather than a judgment. Pooled over the 924 pairs where a judge did not commit, the forced read flips on 89.7% of them when the responses are swapped, against 47.5% read after generation (paired difference +0.422, 95% CI [+0.365, +0.467]). The distortion is specific to what is measured: it moves position bias by 42 points while moving judge accuracy by under one point in seven of ten conditions, so it misleads whoever audits a judge rather than whoever uses one. A second, smaller failure occurs even when the judge does lead with a verdict token, since it sometimes opens with one letter and reasons its way to the other, on 0 to 5.5% of pairs at a rate uncorrelated with compliance. We recommend reporting the rate at which a judge leads with a verdict token, which costs one forward pass and no labels, alongside any position-bias figure.

</details>


### [178] [Measuring Human-Like Bias in LLMs? A Critique of Human-Derived Bias Constructs in LLM Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00070)
*Antonela Tommasel,Markus Schedl*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文批判性地审视了将人类偏见构念（如内隐偏见、锚定效应等）直接迁移至大语言模型评估中的做法，指出由此产生的推论鸿沟，并提出一个分析框架以厘清构念、操作化、推论范围与人类类比边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究者日益借助源自人类的偏见构念来研究大语言模型，以规避直接探询可能掩盖偏见或模型行为表面规范的问题。但心理测量工具本为研究人类认知与社会行为而设计，而模型评估依赖概率、文本补全、排序或模拟决策，二者之间的错配会模糊对模型偏见的不同解读，因此需要系统性地批判与澄清。

Method: 本文采用概念性批判与框架构建的方法。首先剖析推论鸿沟的来源，将其归纳为三类错配：人类衍生构念本身的错配、人与模型之间的差异、以及评估情境的错配。随后提出一个分析框架，将上述要素与可辩护的推论联系起来。

Result: 研究识别出推论鸿沟的三类来源，说明这些错配如何导致对模型偏见含义的混淆，并构建了一个涵盖目标构念、操作化方式、推论范围及人类类比局限的分析框架，用以判定何种解释是有依据的。

Conclusion: 将人类偏见构念迁移至大语言模型评估存在系统性推论风险。研究者在解释模型偏见时，应明确目标构念、操作化手段、推论范围与人类类比的界限，借助所提框架做出有根据的、而非过度延伸的解释。

Abstract: Researchers increasingly use human-derived bias constructs to study Large Language Models (LLMs), including social-cognitive constructs such as implicit bias and stereotype activation, and cognitive biases such as anchoring, framing effects, and confirmation bias. Such approaches offer alternatives to overt bias probes, particularly when direct questioning may obscure bias or when model behaviour appears normatively acceptable. However, adapting human bias constructs to LLMs introduces an inferential gap. Psychological instruments were developed to study human cognition and social behaviour, whereas LLM evaluations rely on probabilities, text completions, rankings, or simulated decisions. This paper critiques human-centered bias evaluation in LLMs. We show how this gap arises from mismatches pertaining to human-derived constructs, human-model differences, and evaluation contexts, which can blur distinct interpretations of model bias. We then introduce a framework providing an analytical lens for relating these elements to warranted interpretations, with attention to target constructs, operationalizations, scope of inference, and limits of human analogy.

</details>


### [179] [Legal text classification in Korean sexual offense cases: from traditional machine learning to large language models with XAI insights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00087)
*Jeongmin Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究针对韩国性犯罪判例的十类法律文本分类任务，比较了传统机器学习、专用小模型与大语言模型的性能，发现经领域微调的KLUE-BERT以99.3%的准确率优于GPT-3.5/4.0等通用模型，并借助可解释AI分析了模型决策依据与误分类原因，指出模型规模之外，领域适配与微调对法律文本分类更为关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NLP发展推动了法律领域AI文本分类应用，但法律文本复杂性高、类别间差异细微，准确分类仍然困难；同时需要明确模型规模与领域适配孰轻孰重，并解决法律AI的性能与可解释性双重需求。

Method: 以十类韩国性犯罪判例为数据集，评估从传统机器学习到LLM的多类法律文本分类模型，包括KLUE-BERT等小规模模型的微调与GPT-3.5、GPT-4.0等通用大模型；采用可解释AI（XAI）技术分析模型预测及误分类案例；并使用接近真实法律案卷记录的KICS数据检验模型泛化能力。

Result: 经法律数据微调的小规模模型KLUE-BERT优于通用大模型和传统机器学习模型，取得最高99.3%的准确率；XAI分析揭示了影响模型决策的语言特征及其在捕捉细微文本线索方面的局限；在KICS数据上泛化测试中，模型难以解读隐含的上下文线索。

Conclusion: 在法律文档分类中，领域适配与微调可能比模型规模更重要；法律AI需兼顾性能与可解释性，XAI可提升法律文本分类的透明度；AI辅助工具能够支持法律从业者的文档分类、法律信息检索与案情评估等任务。

Abstract: The advancement of natural language processing (NLP) has expanded AI-based text classification in the legal domain. However, accurately classifying legal documents remains challenging due to the complexity of legal texts and subtle differences between legal categories. This study evaluates legal text classification models ranging from traditional machine learning techniques to large language models (LLMs) using ten categories of Korean sexual offense precedents. The results show that fine-tuning small-scale models such as KLUE-BERT on legal data outperforms general-purpose models such as GPT-3.5 and GPT-4.0, as well as traditional machine learning models. KLUE-BERT achieved the highest accuracy of 99.3%, indicating that domain adaptation and fine-tuning can be more important than model size for legal document classification. We further employ explainable AI (XAI) techniques to analyze model predictions and misclassification cases. XAI analysis identifies linguistic features influencing model decisions and limitations in capturing subtle textual cues. Using KICS data, which closely resembles real-world legal case records, we further evaluate the model's generalization capabilities and find that it struggles to interpret implicit contextual cues. These findings highlight the importance of both performance and interpretability in legal AI and demonstrate how XAI can improve transparency in legal text classification. AI-assisted tools can support legal professionals in tasks including document classification, legal information retrieval, and case assessment.

</details>


### [180] [BudgetSchemaBench: A Budget-Swept Diagnostic for Schema Context in Text-to-SQL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00092)
*Chen Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 BudgetSchemaBench 诊断基准，研究结构化数据智能体在模式上下文预算约束下，表覆盖与序列化细节的权衡对执行准确率的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型数据目录可跨多库、含数千列，成本约束使得在上下文窗口未满时就需在表覆盖与序列化细节间取舍，而这一权衡缺乏执行层面的系统性诊断。

Method: 构建 BudgetSchemaBench：相关性标签由黄金 SQL 机械推导（无人工/LLM 标注）；使用 80 库合并目录，扫描四种模式上下文预算，在固定各检索器表排序的前提下比较三种表示；引入来源命名空间检查剔除从错误数据库得到正确结果的查询；评估涵盖端到端检索、冻结黄金（保证所需表存在）与移除所需表的探针三种条件。

Result: 主求解器+原始序列化下，预算从目录 2.5% 提至 50%，1,279 道留出题执行准确率在词法检索下提升 18 个百分点，密集检索仅 3 个点（后者在最小预算已找到多数所需表）。移除所需表后，94.6% 的正确预测精确命中其中之一，符合从参数化知识重建缺失模式的解释。冻结黄金条件下两个主求解器的三种表示差异不超过 2 个百分点，最宽配对 95% 置信区间在 ±4 点内；另一家族的推理模型呈相同定性模式。

Conclusion: 当检索受覆盖度限制时，执行准确率对模式预算的敏感性高于所测序列化方式；基准与构建、评估代码已公开。

Abstract: Data agents over structured sources must fit database schema into the model's context window. Large catalogs can span many databases and thousands of columns, so cost constraints may require choosing between table coverage and serialization detail well before the context window is full. We introduce BudgetSchemaBench, an execution-grounded diagnostic for this setting. Its construction derives relevance labels mechanically from gold SQL, without human- or LLM-authored ground truth. Using a pooled 80-database catalog, we sweep four schema-context budgets and compare three representations while keeping each retriever's table ranking fixed. A source-namespace check rejects queries that obtain the correct result from the wrong database. The evaluation covers three conditions: end-to-end retrieval; frozen-gold, in which the required tables are guaranteed; and a probe that removes those tables. For the primary solver with raw serialization, raising the budget from 2.5% to 50% of the catalog improves execution accuracy on 1,279 held-out questions by 18 percentage points under lexical retrieval but only 3 under dense retrieval; the dense retriever already finds most required tables at the smallest budget. When the required tables are removed, 94.6% of correct predictions name one of them exactly, consistent with reconstruction of absent schema from parametric knowledge. For the two main solvers in the frozen-gold condition, the three representations differ by at most 2 percentage points, and the widest paired 95% confidence interval bounds the difference within +/-4 points. We observe the same qualitative patterns with one reasoning model from a different family. When retrieval is coverage-limited, execution accuracy is more sensitive to the schema budget than to the tested serializations. The diagnostic and the code used to construct and evaluate it are publicly available.

</details>


### [181] [FACET at WMT 2026 Automated Translation Quality Evaluation Task](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00096)
*Ahrii Kim,Chanjun Park,Seong-heum Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 FACET：面向 WMT26 自动翻译质量评估任务的无参考提交系统，将评估分解为流畅度、准确度、一致性三通道，单模型三次提示，无需训练组件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不同翻译错误类型需要不同证据：语义是否保留只能对照源文判断，而目标语言是否通顺、实体是否一致则可仅凭译文判断。因此统一评估方式并非最优。

Method: FACET 将评估分解为 Fluency、Accuracy、Consistency 三个独立通道，每个通道只提供其错误类型所需的上下文；使用同一固定模型进行三次提示，合并错误片段后输出三类任务结果：错误片段、质量分数、无错误标签；不含任何训练组件。另有 FACET-C 变体，省略一致性通道。

Result: 在无金标签条件下刻画了 FACET 的预测特性：其系统排序将人工译后编辑译文排在首位；一致性通道改变了约十分之一的片段分数，但系统排序几乎不变。

Conclusion: 按错误类型分配最小必要上下文的多通道分解策略可行且有效；一致性通道对片段级分数有影响但对系统级排序影响有限，说明系统排序主要由流畅度与准确度通道驱动。

Abstract: Different error types in machine translation require different evidence. Whether meaning is preserved can be judged only against the source, while whether the target is well-formed, or whether it names one entity consistently, can be judged from the target alone. We present FACET, our reference-free submission to the WMT26 Automated Translation Quality Evaluation Task, which decomposes evaluation into Fluency, Accuracy, and Consistency passes and gives each pass only the context its error type requires. A single fixed model is prompted three times, and the merged error spans yield the three task outputs, error spans, quality scores, and error-free labels, with no trained components. We also submit FACET-C, which omits the Consistency pass. Without gold labels, we characterize the predictions of FACET. Its system rankings place post-edited human translation first, and the Consistency pass changes about a tenth of segment scores while leaving the ranking nearly unchanged.

</details>


### [182] [Metric-Construction Coupling Inflates Measured Synthetic Dialect Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00164)
*Hyojung Han*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 KoDialectBench，用标识符哈希与评分代码度量合成数据对韩语方言语料监督的恢复程度，发现恢复率高度依赖任务轴与评测指标，并揭示共享构式清单会显著虚高估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 韩语方言语料虽可用，但不可再分发：可能只放出权重，无法基于底层数据复现训练与评测。作者据此追问：合成数据能恢复多少这类监督信号，以及这种恢复能否独立于合成流水线被度量。

Method: 构建 KoDialectBench：覆盖五个地区、三个任务轴的 1,000 条项目，以标识符哈希与评分代码发布，用户可用自有授权副本重建。采用多类合成臂与真实数据对比；并用"精确形式、构式不相交"臂（从规则中扣留 20% 标记类型）在训练规模精确匹配（8,600 例）下测试构式可得性的影响；再通过评测器扫描定义"指标—构式覆盖度（MCC）"。

Result: 恢复率强烈依赖任务轴：最佳合成臂在地区识别上达到真实数据增益的 91.2%，在理解任务上仅 63.7%。生成任务上结论随指标变化：部署的标记词表报告方言性 92.3%、地区匹配 119.3%（后者超过真实数据参考），而基于参考的生成仅 72.4%。标记指标的打分清单完全包含于变换规则可生成的清单内。构式不相交臂在 8,600 例匹配训练规模下，将方言性恢复从 91.8% 降至 8.1%，地区匹配恢复从 101.9% 降至 25.6%，而三项与流水线无关的度量完全未下降。MCC 从 0 升至 1 时，测得的方言性恢复单调上升。

Conclusion: 共享构式与评测清单会实质性抬高对合成数据恢复程度的估计；因此需要独立于合成流水线的度量来评估合成数据对不可分发方言语料监督的恢复效果。

Abstract: Korean dialect corpora are available but not redistributable: weights may be released, while reproducing training and evaluation from the underlying data cannot be. We ask how much of that supervision synthetic data recovers, and whether that recovery can be measured independently of the synthesis pipeline. We contribute KoDialectBench, 1,000 items across five regions on three axes, released as identifier hashes and scoring code so users reconstruct the items from their own licensed copy. Recovery is strongly axis-dependent: our best synthetic arm reaches 91.2% of the real-data gain on region identification but 63.7% on comprehension. On generation the answer depends on the metric: the deployed marker lexicon reports 92.3% on dialectness and 119.3% on region match, the latter exceeding the real-data reference, whereas reference-based generation reaches 72.4%. We find the marker metrics' scoring inventory is entirely contained in the inventory our transformation rules can emit. We test the effect of construction access directly with an exact-form construction-disjoint arm that withholds 20% of marker types from the rules. At exactly matched training size (8,600 examples) it reduces dialectness recovery from 91.8% to 8.1% and region-match recovery from 101.9% to 25.6% on the held-out marker inventory, while the three pipeline-independent measurements do not fall at all. A complementary evaluator sweep defines metric-construction coverage (MCC) and finds measured dialectness recovery increasing monotonically as overlap rises from MCC=0 to MCC=1. Shared construction and evaluation inventories can therefore substantially inflate estimates of synthetic-data recovery.

</details>


### [183] [When a Data Artifact Isn't a Shortcut: Causal Auditing of Synthetic RLVR Corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00202)
*Esther Xin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文审计了RLVR数据构建中"正确答案为真实语料、干扰项为合成文本"所导致的可信度混淆问题，发现表面统计信号虽可检测但在给定预算下未被策略利用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期RLVR流水线通过掩码真实语料片段并让语言模型生成貌似合理的错误选项来构建训练数据，使得正确答案是真实人类文本、干扰项全为合成内容，正确性与来源因此纠缠，策略可能学到"来源"而非"正确性"，本文旨在审计这一风险。

Method: 以GooseReason-0.7M为对象：先用仅读取五个表面统计量的分类器检测正确/干扰项不对称性（315,499个选项）；再通过构建改写匹配的对照语料，在相同训练集规模与固定预算下训练两个策略，进行干预实验。

Result: 分类器AUROC仅0.562，略高于随机；代码领域为0.416低于随机，人工检查发现代码干扰项实为对答案的单算子突变，两类构造上几乎相同。干预实验中，未修改数据臂的利用差距为0.021，对照臂为0.027，可检测的伪影未被利用。

Conclusion: 在该预算下，可检测的构造伪影并未被策略利用，检测到信号不等于模型使用了该信号；这一分离现象与领域特定的构造发现对同类语料构建者具有参考价值，审计流程以近乎仅需CPU的协议形式发布。

Abstract: Several recent pipelines build RLVR training data by masking a span of real corpus text and asking a language model to invent plausible wrong answers around it. The correct option is therefore genuine human prose; every distractor is synthetic. Correctness and provenance become entangled, and a policy could in principle learn the second instead of the first. We audit that possibility in GooseReason-0.7M. First we ask whether the asymmetry is visible at all: a classifier reading only five surface statistics (never the meaning) reaches AUROC 0.562 over 315,499 options, barely above chance. The aggregate hides something, though. Code sits at 0.416, below chance, and manual inspection explains why: code distractors turn out to be single-operator mutations of the gold answer rather than freely written alternatives, so the two classes are nearly identical by construction. Detecting a signal is not the same as showing a model uses it, so we then run an intervention. We build a paraphrase-matched control corpus, hold training-set size identical across arms, and train two policies under one fixed budget. The exploitation gap does not favour the unmodified-data arm: 0.021 against 0.027 for the control. Under our budget, in other words, a detectable artifact went unexploited. We think that dissociation, along with the domain-specific construction finding, is worth knowing for anyone curating corpora of this kind, and we release the audit as a mostly CPU-only protocol.

</details>


### [184] [A Holistic Assessment of the Carbon Footprint of Noor, a Very Large Arabic Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00223)
*Imad Lakim,Ebtesam Almazrouei,Ibrahim Abu Alhaol,Merouane Debbah,Julien Launay*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出对极端规模语言模型Noor进行全生命周期碳足迹评估，涵盖数据收集、研发、预训练、未来推理服务及国际合作等外生成本，发现推理与外生因素对总碳排放影响显著，并探讨减排路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着语言模型规模增大并日益普及，其环境代价（极端规模带来的巨大算力消耗与碳足迹）亟需关注；然而现有机器学习论文的碳报告通常仅局限于训练阶段所用算力，缺乏对项目整体碳账单的全面核算。

Method: 以Noor（面向多任务阿拉伯语、参数规模最高达13B、依托零样本泛化与自然语言指令完成下游任务的极端规模语言模型项目）为对象，开展整体性（holistic）碳足迹评估，核算范围包括数据收集与存储成本、研发（research and development）预算、预训练成本、未来服务（serving）估算，以及开展国际合作所需的其他外生（exogenous）成本。

Result: 评估显示，推理（inference）成本与外生因素可能对项目总碳预算产生显著影响，其占比不可忽略，而仅统计训练算力会低估整体碳足迹。

Conclusion: 极端规模语言模型的碳核算应采用覆盖全项目生命周期的整体视角，并在最后讨论了降低此类模型碳足迹的可能路径。

Abstract: As ever larger language models grow more ubiquitous, it is crucial to consider their environmental impact. Characterised by extreme size and resource use, recent generations of models have been criticised for their voracious appetite for compute, and thus significant carbon footprint. Although reporting of carbon impact has grown more common in machine learning papers, this reporting is usually limited to compute resources used strictly for training. In this work, we propose a holistic assessment of the footprint of an extreme-scale language model, Noor. Noor is an ongoing project aiming to develop the largest multi-task Arabic language models -- with up to 13B parameters -- leveraging zero-shot generalisation to enable a wide range of downstream tasks via natural language instructions. We assess the total carbon bill of the entire project: starting with data collection and storage costs, including research and development budgets, pretraining costs, future serving estimates, and other exogenous costs necessary for this international cooperation. Notably, we find that inference costs and exogenous factors can have a significant impact on total budget. Finally, we discuss pathways to reduce the carbon footprint of extreme-scale models.

</details>


### [185] [CAVE-Mem: Boundary-Aware Experience Validation for Memory Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00238)
*Xinyu Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出免训练的CAVE-Mem框架，将经验表示为带适用、边界与效用条件的类型化干预算子，仅当算子匹配当前状态时才改变基础答案，否则弃权，在长期对话记忆、多跳问答与长文档叙事推理上稳定优于仅基于相关性的经验复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有经验记忆系统主要优化相关性，把与当前状态相似的过往搜索经验注入提示；但当记忆基底、问题意图、答案粒度或证据边界发生变化时，相关经验也可能是有害的。

Method: CAVE-Mem为免训练框架：先将经验表示为类型化干预算子，并附带适用性、边界与效用条件；随后先获得基础记忆检索答案，仅当该算子与当前记忆基底、答案契约、证据边界及交叉拟合效用相匹配时，才允许其修改基础答案，否则系统弃权。

Result: 在长期对话记忆、多跳问答与长文档叙事推理三类任务上，相较仅基于相关性的经验复用取得一致提升。

Conclusion: 经验复用不应仅依赖相关性，而应通过适用性、边界与效用的显式匹配来决定是否采纳，必要时弃权以避免有害迁移。

Abstract: Long-term memory agents increasingly rely on it- erative search and reusable experience to answer questions over large personal, factual, or narrative histories. However, current experience-memory systems largely optimize relevance: they re- trieve past search lessons that appear similar to the current state and inject them into the prompt. A relevant experience can still be harmful when the memory substrate, question intent, answer granularity, or evidence boundary changes. We propose CAVE- Mem, a training-free framework that represents experience as a typed intervention operator with applicability, boundary, and utility conditions. CAVE-Mem first obtains a base memory-search answer, then allows an operator to change it only if the oper- ator matches the current substrate, answer contract, evidence boundary, and cross-fitted utility; otherwise the system abstains. Experiments across long-term conversational memory, multi-hop question answering, and long-document narrative reasoning show consistent gains over relevance-only experience reuse.

</details>


### [186] [Signed Lexical Confidence for Risk-Calibrated Intent Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00262)
*Yezhou Cheng,Zehua Yang,Bojun Lin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一种"带符号词汇门"（signed lexical gate），将句子分类器的logit margin与稀疏词汇模型证据结合，用于选择性意图路由的置信度增强，并配以二项式校准选择阈值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 选择性意图路由需要助手对可靠预测采取行动、对不确定请求进行延迟处理。但标准置信度分数主要反映基座模型的表示，未充分利用互补证据，因此存在在不改变基座模型决策的前提下引入额外证据的机会。

Method: 构建带符号词汇门：将句子分类器的logit margin与稀疏词汇模型对分类器预测意图的支持度相结合；对词汇一致性赋予正证据，对词汇偏好的竞争意图赋予负证据；再通过独立的二项式校准阶段为指定风险目标选择操作阈值。与无符号词汇置信度和硬一致性规则进行对照。

Result: 在BANKING77、CLINC150、HWU64各十次运行中，风险-覆盖率曲线下面积相对仅语义的学习门分别降低15.8%、15.1%、11.8%；在名义5%错误目标下，BANKING77与HWU64接受覆盖率分别提升1.83和5.14个百分点，CLINC150已接近全覆盖；在更严格的2%目标下，同步二项式程序在全部30个数据集-运行组合中均产生非空策略；对照实验显示该特征优于无符号词汇置信度特征，相比二值一致性有数据集相关的增益。

Conclusion: 提出的双特征门为风险校准的意图路由提供了紧凑、可解释的置信度增强，同时保持基座分类器的预测不变。

Abstract: Selective intent routing allows an assistant to act on reliable predictions while deferring uncertain requests. Standard confidence scores primarily reflect the base model's representation, leaving an opportunity to incorporate complementary evidence without changing its decisions. We introduce a signed lexical gate that combines a sentence classifier's logit margin with a sparse lexical model's support for the classifier's predicted intent. By assigning positive evidence to lexical agreement and negative evidence to a lexically favored competing intent, the gate retains more information than either unsigned lexical confidence or a hard agreement rule. An independent binomial calibration stage selects an operating threshold for a specified risk target. Across ten runs on BANKING77, CLINC150, and HWU64, the proposed score reduces area under the risk-coverage curve by 15.8%, 15.1%, and 11.8% relative to a learned semantic-only gate. At a nominal 5% error target, it increases accepted coverage by 1.83 and 5.14 percentage points on BANKING77 and HWU64, while CLINC150 is already near full coverage. At a stricter 2% target, the simultaneous binomial procedure yields a nonempty policy in all 30 dataset-run combinations at the available calibration budgets. Matched controls show that the proposed feature improves average error ranking over the tested unsigned lexical-confidence feature, with dataset-dependent gains over binary agreement. The resulting two-feature gate provides a compact, interpretable confidence enhancement for risk-calibrated intent routing while preserving the base classifier's predictions.

</details>


### [187] [Certainty Is Not Just Correctness: Rethinking Token-Level Certainty in LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00296)
*Yunfan Zhou,Ye Zhu,Zhihai Wang,Jianguo Yao,Haibing Guan,Xijun Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文通过受控实验评估了LLM中token级certainty的预测能力，发现其在识别模型能答对的问题上优于区分同一问题的对错答案，且信息分布随token类型、位置和生成阶段系统变化；据此在测试时计算中早期分配采样数量、末期加权投票，准确率从78.71%提升至79.54%，token成本降低82.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Token级certainty常被用作正确性的代理指标，但其效果既取决于certainty分数所包含的信息，也取决于这些分数的使用方式。作者希望厘清certainty究竟能预测什么、在何处有效，从而指导更合理的应用。

Method: 在多个模型和任务上进行受控实证评估，区分两类预测目标：识别模型更可能答对的问题，以及区分同一问题下的正确与错误回答；同时分析certainty在不同token类型、词内位置及生成阶段的变化规律。

Result: certainty在识别模型可能答对的问题上普遍优于区分同一问题的对错回答；certainty随token类型和词内位置系统性变化，反映词与文本形式的局部属性；问题难度信息在生成早期出现，而较弱的答案正确性信息更集中于生成末期。

Conclusion: certainty所提供信息的价值取决于预测目标、模型、certainty度量以及聚合时所包含的token位置。基于此，在生成早期用certainty分配回答数量、在末期用certainty加权投票，相比固定采样多数投票基线，准确率由78.71%升至79.54%，生成token成本降低82.4%。

Abstract: Token-level certainty is widely used as a proxy for correctness in LLM training and inference. However, the performance of certainty-based methods depends both on the information in certainty scores and on how those scores are used. We therefore directly assess certainty's predictive ability through controlled empirical evaluations across models and tasks. We distinguish two prediction targets: identifying questions a model is more likely to answer correctly and distinguishing correct from incorrect responses to the same question. In our experiments, certainty is generally better at identifying questions a model is likely to answer correctly than at distinguishing correct from incorrect responses to the same question. Certainty also varies systematically across token types and positions within words, reflecting local properties of words and text form. Information about question difficulty appears early in generation, while the weaker information about answer correctness is more concentrated near the end. These findings show that the information certainty provides for decisions depends on the prediction target, the model, the certainty metric, and which token positions in the response are included in aggregation. We further demonstrate the practical value of these findings for test-time compute. We allocate the number of responses using certainty early in generation and weight answer votes using certainty near the end of each response. Compared with a fixed-sampling majority-voting baseline, this approach increases overall accuracy from 78.71\% to 79.54\% while reducing generated-token cost by 82.4\%.

</details>


### [188] [DuplexSpeechBench-Document Grounding: Benchmarking Document Grounding and Hallucinations in Voice Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00316)
*Puneet Mathur,Nedim Lipka,Zeyu Jin,Dinesh Manocha*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 DSB-DG 基准，用于评估语音智能体在外部文档接地方面的能力，覆盖五大专业领域、1636 组问答对，并揭示级联架构与全双工/实时系统在有效接地容量上的显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音智能体虽能实现低延迟、自然交互，但其将响应忠实锚定于外部文档的能力尚未被充分探索，缺乏系统性评测手段。

Method: 构建 DSB-DG 基准，聚焦三类失效模式：上下文饱和（文档长度增加下的接地能力）、接地衰减（多轮对话中文档事实的保持）、主动接地（上下文重注入是否缓解对话漂移）。基准包含来自 50 份文档、覆盖五大专业领域的 1636 组对抗性验证问答对，支持接地准确率、幻觉与响应延迟的全自动评估。

Result: 在级联式、专有全双工与实时系统、开放权重语音到语音架构上评测，发现有效接地容量差异显著：级联流水线（ASR-LLM-TTS）接地准确率最高，Gemini-Live 与 GPT-Realtime 紧随其后；开放权重系统表现出独特失效模式，尤其是上下文容量骤降与多轮接地衰减。

Conclusion: 接地保真度随上下文与对话负载增加而下降，失效多表现为无依据生成而非拒答，上下文接地仍是可靠全双工语音智能体的关键未解难题。

Abstract: Voice agents enable low-latency, natural interaction, yet their ability to faithfully ground responses in external documents remains underexplored. We introduce DuplexSpeechBench-Document Grounding (DSB-DG), a benchmark for evaluating document grounding in voice agents across five professional domains. DSB-DG targets three failure modes: Context Saturation, which measures grounding under increasing document length; Grounding Decay, which measures retention of document facts across multi-turn dialogue; and Proactive Grounding, which evaluates whether context re-injection mitigates conversational drift. The benchmark contains 1,636 adversarially verified QA pairs from 50 documents covering five professional domains, and supports fully automatic evaluation of grounding accuracy, hallucination, and response latency. Across systems spanning cascaded, proprietary full-duplex and real-time, and open-weight speech2speech architectures, we find substantial differences in effective grounding capacity. While cascaded pipeline (ASR-LLM-TTS) achieves the highest grounding accuracy, Gemini-Live and GPT-Realtime closely trail behind. Open-weight systems exhibit distinct failure modes, most notably an abrupt context-capacity collapse and multi-turn grounding decay. More broadly, grounding fidelity degrades with context and conversational load, and failures frequently manifest as unsupported generations rather than abstention. We show that contextual grounding as a key unresolved challenge for reliable full-duplex voice agents.

</details>


### [189] [Refusal Localizes, the Damage Relocates: Safety Layers Under Few-Sample Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00320)
*Jungseob Lee,Dongyub Jude Lee,Sugyeong Eo,Seongtae Hong,Seungyoon Lee,Heuiseok Lim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文检验了基于定位的安全防御能否在攻击方式变化后依然有效，发现攻击者可绕过被恢复方法定位的区域并击败跨检查点有效的修复手段，据此提出五项针对自适应微调防御的检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有工作将大模型的安全拒答行为定位到特定层、方向与token，暗示这些位置可作为防护目标；但作者要检验这种"定位与恢复"是否能支撑在攻击发生变化时仍然稳健的防御。

Method: 在来自四个模型家族的六个检查点上，先用有害与良性提示测试攻击后隐藏状态是否仍线性可分，并将干净隐藏状态patch回被攻陷模型以寻找恢复拒答的转移深度；随后基于此前的层冻结防御，冻结该深度以下所有层并重复攻击；第二项研究则移除更新中前两个奇异方向以修复仅注意力微调造成的破坏，并在Llama-3.1-8B上测试普通训练扰动、攻击者分散更新以及基于良性微调校准的谱检测器。

Result: 攻击后有害与良性提示在六个检查点上仍线性可分，patch干净隐藏状态可在可复现的转移深度恢复拒答；但在一百个有害样本下，冻结到该深度后所有六个检查点的拒答率仍接近零，恢复转移出现在冻结边界之上。移除前两个奇异方向可在四个检查点的短时仅注意力微调后恢复拒答，但在Llama-3.1-8B上，普通训练引起的改变会削弱该修复，攻击者分散更新即可将其击败；基于良性Llama微调校准的谱检测器在该检查点上漏掉了大多数修复失败案例。

Conclusion: 定位性冻结在少量有害样本被无意混入训练数据时仍有助于保持拒答，但总体表明攻击者能够绕过由恢复方法识别出的区域，并击败在多个检查点上有效的修复，因此提出了针对自适应微调防御的五项检验。

Abstract: Fine-tuning adapts aligned large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks, but a few dozen harmful examples can remove their refusal of harmful requests. Prior work localizes safety-related behavior to specific layers, directions, and tokens, suggesting targets for protection. We test whether successful localization and recovery support defenses that survive changes in the attack. Across six checkpoints from four model families, harmful and benign prompts remain linearly separable after attack, and patching full clean hidden states into the compromised model restores refusal at a reproducible transition depth. Building on a prior layer-freezing defense, we freeze every layer up to this depth and repeat the attack. At a hundred harmful examples, refusal remains near zero on all six checkpoints, with recovery transitions above the frozen boundary. In a second study, removing the update's top two singular directions restores refusal after short attention-only fine-tunes on four checkpoints. On Llama-3.1-8B, ordinary training changes weaken this repair and an attacker who spreads the update defeats it. A spectral detector calibrated on benign Llama fine-tunes misses most repair failures on that checkpoint. Localized freezing can nevertheless help preserve refusal when a few harmful examples enter training data unintentionally. These results show that an attacker can bypass a region identified by recovery and defeat a repair that works across multiple checkpoints, motivating five checks for defenses against adaptive fine-tuning. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/refusal-relocates.

</details>


### [190] [CAST: Cost-Aware Speculative Trees from One-Pass Block Drafters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00321)
*Jungseob Lee,Sugyeong Eo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CAST 将块式草稿产生的多个候选打包成树，用一次目标模型前向验证，并按部署实测延迟自适应确定树宽，在不改变输出分布的前提下加速推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 块式草稿器一次前向即可为一整块未来 token 打分，但标准解码只验证得分最高的链，丢弃其余候选；这些候选已被打分，验证更多候选只增加目标计算而不增加草稿开销，因此存在可挖掘的加速空间。此外，最优树宽高度依赖具体部署，固定宽度并非最优。

Method: 提出 CAST（Cost-Aware Speculative Trees）：把块草稿器的候选 token 组织成树，在单次目标模型前向中验证；不修改目标模型、草稿器权重与解码规则。树宽通过成本感知准则确定——只要下一个候选带来的期望收益超过其增加的验证时间就继续加宽，宽度由一次延迟测量自适应导出，无需网格搜索。

Result: 在三个 GPU 代际、两个模型族、五个领域的八个设置中，CAST 在预测宽度下均快于标准链式验证，最高提升 43%。最优宽度与部署强相关：在验证成本因 kernel 边界跳变的场景下，128 token 的树仅比标准链快 2%，而按预测宽度构建的树快 20%。同时证明在贪心与采样解码下 CAST 均不改变目标输出分布。

Conclusion: CAST 通过复用已打分的草稿候选并自适应匹配部署验证成本，实现了免调参、无损分布的投机解码加速，说明树宽应按部署的延迟特性而非固定值选择。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by drafting future tokens cheaply and verifying them with the target model in parallel. Block drafters score a whole block of future tokens in one forward pass, yet standard decoding verifies only the top-scoring chain and discards the other candidates. Because these candidates are already scored, verifying more of them adds target computation but no extra drafting. We introduce CAST (Cost-Aware Speculative Trees), which packs these candidates into a tree and verifies it in a single target pass, leaving the target model, drafter weights, and decoding rule untouched. To decide how wide the tree should be, CAST adds candidates while the expected gain from the next one outweighs the verification time it adds. The width therefore adapts to each deployment from a latency measurement, without sweeping over widths. We evaluate CAST across five domains on three GPU generations and two model families. At its predicted width, CAST is faster than the standard chain in all eight settings, by up to 43%. We also find that the best width depends strongly on the deployment. Where verification cost jumps at a kernel boundary, a 128-token tree is only 2% faster than the standard chain, whereas the tree at the predicted width is 20% faster. Furthermore, we prove that CAST leaves the target output distribution unchanged under both greedy and sampled decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/CAST.

</details>


### [191] [Dissonant ballerinas and crafty carrots: a comparative multi-modal analysis of Italian brain rot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00402)
*Anca Dinu,Andra-Maria Florescu,Marius Micluta-Campeanu,Stefana-Arina Tabusca,Claudiu Creanga,Andreiana Mihail*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对意大利语与罗马尼亚语"brain rot"迷因进行多模态对比分析，构建CRIB数据集（240个TikTok视频），发现流行度与文本/声学特征无显著相关，罗马尼亚语中视频节奏（剪辑速度）是成功强预测因子，两语言在文本情感、困惑度、韵律及声学特征上存在显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究"brain rot"迷因的吸引力来源，以及意大利语与罗马尼亚语版本之间的语言与文化差异，填补该新兴网络文化现象多模态对比研究的空白。

Method: 构建CRIB数据集：人工筛选240个TikTok视频，按语言（意大利语、罗马尼亚语）和流行度分层。对文本、声学、视觉特征进行多模态分析，并开展跨语言对比与流行度相关性分析。

Result: 流行度与文本要素（情感、荒诞性、押韵）及声学要素（人声特征、声音情感）无显著相关；罗马尼亚语中视频层面动态（更快的剪辑速度与整体节奏）是成功的强预测因子。跨语言差异显著：意大利语brain rot文本更消极、困惑度更高、押韵更多，声音旋律范围与响度更高；罗马尼亚语音频频谱更明亮、音高变化更不规则。

Conclusion: "brain rot"迷因的吸引力更多依赖视频层面的节奏动态而非文本或声学内容；意、罗两语版本在文本与声学维度呈现系统性差异，反映了各自的语言与文化特点，CRIB数据集为后续多模态迷因研究提供了资源。

Abstract: This paper presents a comparative multi-modal analysis of Italian and Romanian brain rot memes, investigating the factors that contribute to its appeal and the linguistic and cultural distinctions between the two versions. To conduct this analysis, we introduce a multi-modal brain rot dataset named CRIB (Collection of Romanian and Italian Brain rot), a manually curated collection of 240 TikTok videos stratified by language (Italian, Romanian) and popularity, on which we examine textual, acoustic, and visual features. Our findings indicate that popularity is not significantly correlated with textual elements like sentiment, absurdity, or rhyme, or acoustic elements such as vocal features or sentiment of the sound. Instead, in Romanian language, video-level dynamics, specifically faster cutting speeds and a more rapid overall pace, are strong predictors of a video's success. The cross-linguistic analysis reveals significant differences. Italian brain rot is textually more negative, exhibits higher perplexity, and uses more rhyme, while its sound is characterized by higher melodic range and loudness. Romanian audio is spectrally brighter with more erratic pitch variations.

</details>


### [192] [LLM-as-a-Judge for Low-Resource Languages: Adapting Ragas and Comparative Ranking for Romanian](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00406)
*Claudiu Creanga,Liviu P. Dinu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文面向罗马尼亚语等低资源语言，验证"LLM-as-a-Judge"在RAG评测中的可行性：构建人工标注数据集AdminRo-Eval，并对比直接打分、比较排序、细粒度分解三种评测策略在忠实性、答案相关性、上下文相关性指标上与人类判断的一致性。结果显示评测策略需因指标而异，Gemini 2.5 Pro可作为罗马尼亚语RAG自动评测的稳健基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低资源语言（LRLs）的RAG系统评测困难，传统基于参考答案的指标在该场景下失效，亟需验证"LLM-as-a-Judge"范式在罗马尼亚语中的可用性，并建立可信的自动化评测基准。

Method: 1) 基于Ragas框架进行适配，采用新一代模型（Gemini 2.5 与 Gemini 3）；2) 构建AdminRo-Eval——由母语者标注的罗马尼亚语行政文档数据集，作为评测基准的真值；3) 针对Faithfulness、Answer Relevance、Context Relevance三项指标，对比直接打分（direct scoring）、比较排序（comparative ranking）、细粒度分解（granular decomposition）三种评测方法。

Result: 评测策略需与指标匹配：细粒度分解在Faithfulness上获得最高的人类一致性（Gemini 2.5 Pro达96%），比较排序在Answer Relevance上表现更优（90%）。同时，轻量级模型在低资源语言的复杂推理任务上表现欠佳，而Gemini 2.5 Pro架构可建立稳健且可迁移的罗马尼亚语RAG评测基线。

Conclusion: "LLM-as-a-Judge"范式经方法适配后可用于罗马尼亚语RAG评测，但须按指标选择相应评测策略；Gemini 2.5 Pro被证明为适用于低资源语言场景的可靠自动化评测基线，AdminRo-Eval可作为该领域的基准数据集。

Abstract: Evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems remains a challenge for Low-Resource Languages (LRLs), where standard reference-based metrics fall short. This paper investigates the viability of the "LLM-as-a-Judge" paradigm for Romanian by adapting the Ragas framework using next-generation models (Gemini 2.5 and Gemini 3). We introduce AdminRo-Eval, a curated dataset of Romanian administrative documents annotated by native speakers, to serve as a ground truth for benchmarking automated evaluators. We compare three evaluation methodologies - direct scoring, comparative ranking, and granular decomposition - across metrics for Faithfulness, Answer Relevance, and Context Relevance. Our findings reveal that evaluation strategies must be metric-specific: granular decomposition achieves the highest human alignment for Faithfulness (96% with Gemini 2.5 Pro), while comparative ranking outperforms in Answer Relevance (90%). Furthermore, we demonstrate that while lightweight models struggle with complex reasoning in LRLs, the Gemini 2.5 Pro architecture establishes a robust, transferable baseline for automated Romanian RAG evaluation.

</details>


### [193] [UniBuc at SemEval-2024 Task 2: Tailored Prompting with Solar for Clinical NLI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00408)
*Marius Micluta-Campeanu,Claudiu Creanga,Ana-Maria Bucur,Ana Sabina Uban,Liviu P. Dinu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: UniBuc团队在SemEval 2024 Task 2中，使用未微调的SOLAR Instruct模型，通过输入操作与定制化提示策略，取得0.72的一致性分数，排名第14。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索在不进行微调的情况下，利用现有大语言模型解决临床试验安全生物医学自然语言推理任务的可行性，并提升模型对临床试验报告（CTR）各章节的推理一致性。

Method: 采用SOLAR Instruct模型，不做任何微调；重点进行输入操作与定制化提示。针对CTR的各个章节分别设计提示语，并在零样本（zero-shot）和少样本（few-shots）两种设置下进行实验。

Result: 在任务中获得0.72的一致性分数，在排行榜上位列第14名。

Conclusion: 详尽的错误分析表明，模型倾向于走捷径并依赖简单启发式规则，尤其在处理语义保持的改动（semantic-preserving changes）时表现明显。

Abstract: This paper describes the approach of the UniBuc team in tackling the SemEval 2024 Task 2: Safe Biomedical Natural Language Inference for Clinical Trials. We used SOLAR Instruct, without any fine-tuning, while focusing on input manipulation and tailored prompting. By customizing prompts for individual CTR sections, in both zero-shot and few-shots settings, we managed to achieve a consistency score of 0.72, ranking 14th in the leaderboard. Our thorough error analysis revealed that our model has a tendency to take shortcuts and rely on simple heuristics, especially when dealing with semantic-preserving changes.

</details>


### [194] [EurekaBench: Measuring Agentic Ability to Discover New Scientific Insights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00492)
*Jiayi Geng,Zhengxuan Wu,Kevin S. Chen,Seungone Kim,Joseph Janssen,Zora Zhiruo Wang,Bhupalee Kalita,Runtian Gao,Aaron Ho,Andrew Oakleigh Nelson,Olexandr Isayev,Francisco Villaescusa-Navarro,Ching-Yao Lai,Howard Chen,Graham Neubig*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出EurekaBench，一个跨领域基准，用于评估AI智能体在长周期实验中从观测数据发现可解释机制的能力，并以可推导的科学洞见（而非仅预测精度）作为核心衡量标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受牛顿通过迭代分析行星数据、以数学方程描述规律、并不断用月球轨道修正理论从而发现万有引力定律的启发，作者希望探究AI智能体能否做出类似的科学发现。现有评估多聚焦预测精度，缺乏对"发现能解释观测并支撑科学洞见的机制"这一能力的系统测量。

Method: 构建EurekaBench跨领域基准：包含专家验证的26个长周期任务，覆盖神经科学、计算机科学、化学、天体物理、地球物理和等离子体物理，共涉及306条科学洞见，作为所发现机制应能支撑的评判依据。评估框架从三个维度考察科学发现能力：遵循已知科学约束的能力、所发现机制的预测准确性、以及机制能否产生科学洞见或指导未来研究。

Result: 实验结果显示，当前AI智能体常过度专注于预测精度优化，在预测精度上甚至超越人类科学家，但在推导科学洞见方面表现明显不足。

Conclusion: AI智能体在科学发现中的能力存在结构性失衡：善于拟合预测，却难以从机制中提炼科学洞见。EurekaBench为衡量这一差距提供了跨领域、以洞见为导向的评估标准，指出未来AI科学发现研究应超越单纯的预测精度优化。

Abstract: When Isaac Newton discovered the law of gravitation, he did so through an iterative process of analyzing observed data such as planetary patterns, finding the underlying mechanisms by describing patterns in mathematical equations, and refining his theory against the Moon's orbit, revealing the startling insight that the same force governs both falling apples and orbiting planets. Would it be possible for AI agents to make similar discoveries? To measure this ability, we introduce EurekaBench, a cross-domain benchmark that tests AI agents' ability to conduct long-horizon experiments and discover mechanisms that explain observations. We evaluate these mechanisms by the scientific insights that can be derived from them. EurekaBench contains an expert-verified set of 26 long-horizon tasks across neuroscience, computer science, chemistry, astrophysics, geophysics, and plasma physics, with a total of 306 scientific insights that the discovered mechanisms are expected to support. Our evaluation framework tests three axes of scientific discovery: agents' ability to follow known scientific constraints, the predictive accuracy of the discovered mechanisms, and whether these mechanisms yield scientific insights or inform future research. Our results show that current AI agents often overly fixate on predictive accuracy optimization, surpassing human scientists, while falling substantially short in deriving scientific insights.

</details>


### [195] [Rules Amortize, Pairings Don't: Linguistic Structure Determines What Latent Task Representations Can Replace In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00526)
*Gunmay Jhingran*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文研究哪些语言操作可以从提示词（prompt）中"摊销"（amortize）为潜任务表征：用一个小型网络读取少样本支持集的几何统计量，生成对冻结GPT-2-large/XL残差流的输入条件化加性更新。结果发现，能由模型"执行"的语言操作可被摊销为潜表征（甚至超越ICL），而任意配对（如反义）的映射无法摊销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期的ICL理论表明，静态任务向量只能充当单个合成示范，在高秩映射（如词级双射）上必然失败。作者据此提出语言学版本的问题：究竟哪些语言操作可以被摊销出提示词，从而以零样本推理成本复现少样本行为？

Method: 训练一个2.6M参数的网络，读取少样本支持集的几何结构（质心、主子空间、谱，仅计算一次并缓存），在冻结的GPT-2-large/XL中部某一层，对查询残差流产生输入条件化的加性更新。实验覆盖八个屈折方向和一个词汇关系，采用规范划分以避免方向间的反向对泄漏。

Result: 在三种情形下结果分化：(1) 正向屈折，10-shot ICL较强（0.67-0.89）而抽取的任务向量崩溃（≤0.06），该变换以严格零样本逐查询成本匹配ICL；(2) 词形还原方向，冻结GPT-2能执行但10个示范系统性无法传达（1.5B时ICL仅0.13-0.48），该变换不受ICL上限约束，达到0.78-0.92，最高超出ICL 72个点（past→present：0.85 vs. 0.13）；(3) 任意配对（反义），所有摊销器在所有规模、容量和随机种子下均停滞在ICL的一半左右。对照实验显示，支持流形是因果必要的任务指纹：错误任务流形使准确率崩溃至≤0.06，仅查询变体无法区分共享输入空间的任务，留一任务迁移为零。

Conclusion: 可生产性规则（如屈折、词形还原）能够被摊销为潜任务表征，且有时比提示词所传达的效果更好；而记忆性配对（如反义）则无法被摊销。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) can be amortized into latent objects (task vectors, function vectors, context vectors) that recover few-shot behavior at zero-shot inference cost, but recent theory shows a static vector acts as a single synthetic demonstration and must fail on high-rank mappings such as word-level bijections. We ask a linguistic version of this question: which linguistic operations can be amortized out of the prompt? We train a 2.6M-parameter network that reads the geometry of a few-shot support set (centroid, principal subspace, spectrum, computed once and cached) and produces an input-conditioned additive update to the query's residual stream at a mid-depth layer of a frozen GPT-2-large/XL. Across eight inflectional directions and one lexical relation, under a canonical split that bars inverted-pair leakage between directions, three regimes emerge. On forward inflection, where 10-shot ICL is strong (0.67-0.89) and extracted task vectors collapse (<=0.06), the transform matches ICL at strictly zero-shot per-query cost. On lemmatization directions, which frozen GPT-2 can execute but 10 demonstrations systematically fail to convey (ICL 0.13-0.48 at 1.5B), the transform is not capped by ICL at all: it reaches 0.78-0.92, up to +72 points over ICL (past to present: 0.85 vs. 0.13). On arbitrary pairings (antonymy) every amortizer plateaus near half of ICL at every scale, capacity, and seed tested. Controls show the support manifold acts as a causally necessary task fingerprint: wrong-task manifolds collapse accuracy to <=0.06, query-only variants cannot disambiguate tasks sharing an input space, and leave-one-task-out transfer is zero. Productive rules amortize into latent task representations, sometimes better than prompting can convey them; memorized pairings do not.

</details>


### [196] [Assessing the Impact of Language Disparity on Multilingual Linguistic Ability in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00540)
*Zhanyu Chen,Jaap Jumelet*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统考察了评估范式、后训练与语言资源可得性三者的交互作用：在覆盖101种语言的句法最小对基准MultiBLiMP上，用四种方法评估六个模型家族的基座与后训练模型，发现后训练损害语法能力且低资源语言代价最高，隐知识仅在高资源语言可测，母语提示可恢复低资源语言的隐藏能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关于多语言语言模型语法能力的结论随测量方式而剧烈变化，但"评估范式×后训练×语言资源可得性"之间的交互作用此前未被系统研究，导致对低资源语言能力的评估可能存在系统性低估。

Method: 以MultiBLiMP（涵盖101种语言的句法最小对基准）为测试平台，选取六个模型家族的基座模型与后训练模型，采用四种评估方法进行对比评测，并辅以母语提示（native-language prompting）条件。

Result: 三项主要发现：（1）后训练会削弱语法能力，该效应幅度随模型规模增大而被不均匀地缓解，而低资源语言承担最高代价；（2）后训练模型保留了无法通过显式提示表达出来的语法知识，但仅在高资源语言中可测——低资源场景下基线接近随机水平，几乎无隐藏知识可显现；（3）母语提示能恢复低资源语言上原本隐藏的能力，说明只有高资源语言才能直接从无提示概率中探测语法能力。

Conclusion: 多语言语法评估必须采用"语言感知、多范式"的评测协议，避免系统性低估低资源语言的能力。

Abstract: Claims about the grammatical competence of multilingual language models vary sharply with how competence is measured, yet the interaction between evaluation paradigm, post-training, and language resource availability has not been systematically examined. We evaluate base and post-trained models from six families on MultiBLiMP, a syntactic minimal-pair benchmark covering 101 languages, using four evaluation methods. We report three principal findings. First, post-training degrades grammatical competence, but the magnitude of this effect is reduced unevenly by model scale, while low-resource languages bear the highest cost. Second, post-trained models retain grammatical knowledge they cannot articulate through explicit prompting, yet this is measurable only in high-resource languages, because near-chance baselines in low-resource settings leave little knowledge to hide. Third, native-language prompting recovers otherwise hidden competence on low-resource languages, demonstrating that only high-resource languages can be probed directly from unprompted probabilities. We conclude that multilingual grammatical evaluation must adopt language-informed, multi-paradigm protocols to avoid systematically underestimating low-resource abilities.

</details>


### [197] [Can LLMs Reason Over Long Horizons? An Empirical Evaluation of Context Strategies for Longitudinal Clinical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00562)
*Taye Akinrele,Noorbakhsh Amiri Golilarz,Subash Neupane,Sudip Mittal,Shahram Rahimi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文比较五种上下文策略在四个开源LLM上的纵向临床推理表现，发现证据的组织方式比历史长度更关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纵向临床推理要求LLM从长期病史中识别并整合分散的相关证据。尽管长上下文模型能处理更多信息，但提供更多病史并不一定让相关证据更易获取或提升推理能力，因此需探究上下文策略的影响。

Method: 在MedLoCoMo基准上，对四种开源权重LLM比较五种上下文策略（Full、Recent、Episodic、Semantic、Hybrid），评估答案正确性、对查询-证据距离的鲁棒性，以及对含无支撑前提问题的弃答能力。

Result: Episodic和Hybrid总体准确率最强；Recent Context随支持证据距离增大退化最明显，而Episodic和Hybrid在远距离下保持最高准确率。对抗性问题分析表明，在可回答问题上的强表现未必转化为对无支撑结论的成功弃答。

Conclusion: 可靠的纵向推理不仅取决于LLM能访问多少病史，更关键取决于相关证据如何被选择和呈现以供推理。

Abstract: Longitudinal clinical reasoning requires large language models (LLMs) to identify and integrate relevant evidence distributed across extended patient histories. Although long-context models can process increasingly large amounts of information, providing more history does not necessarily make relevant evidence more accessible or improve reasoning. We compare five context strategies (Full, Recent, Episodic, Semantic, and Hybrid) on MedLoCoMo across four open-weight LLMs, examining answer correctness, robustness to query-evidence distance, and abstention on questions with unsupported premises. Episodic and Hybrid generally achieve the strongest overall accuracy, while Recent Context degrades most as supporting evidence becomes more distant; Episodic and Hybrid maintain the highest accuracy at long distances. Analysis of adversarial questions further shows that strong performance on answerable questions does not necessarily translate to successful abstention when the available history does not support the requested conclusion. These findings show that reliable longitudinal reasoning depends not only on how much history an LLM can access, but critically on how relevant evidence is selected and presented for reasoning.

</details>


### [198] [Emergent Unfaithfulness: How Alignment Training Causes Language Models to Silently Override Task Faithfulness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00568)
*Pardis Sadat Zahraei,Janvijay Singh,Gokhan Tur,Dilek Hakkani-Tur*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文揭示了"对齐诱发的不忠实"（AIU）现象：对齐后的模型会系统性地偏离输入中不安全或敏感的内容且不披露修改，该现象随规模增大反而加剧（逆向缩放律），并在DPO阶段被放大且最难察觉，据此提出能力-对齐-忠实性"三难困境"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有研究主要关注能力与对齐、能力与忠实性之间的权衡，而对齐与忠实性之间的冲突尚缺乏系统研究。作者希望填补这一空白，并证明该冲突无法被简单地归因于知识或推理错误。

Method: 提出"对齐诱发的不忠实"（AIU）概念，将其与能力驱动的不忠实区分开；构建受控数据集 FaithConflict 以分离两类冲突；设计两套互补分类体系——行为层面（B1-B8）与思维链推理层面（C0-C6）；跨模型、跨规模及跨训练检查点进行评测，并测试基于提示的缓解手段。

Result: AIU 随模型规模增大而上升，且增速快于能力驱动的不忠实，呈现逆向缩放律；中间检查点显示该现象在后训练阶段被放大，其中 DPO 阶段差距增长最快且最不可见；基于提示的缓解方法无法解决该问题。

Conclusion: 能力、对齐与忠实性三者之间构成"三难困境"，对LLM的设计与评估提出了新挑战；对齐机制本身可能成为不忠实性的来源，需在模型开发与评测中予以专门考量。

Abstract: Large language models are characterized by three key properties: capability, alignment, and faithfulness. Prior work studies the tradeoffs between capability and alignment, and between capability and faithfulness, but a third tension remains underexplored: the alignment-faithfulness conflict. We show that aligned models systematically deviate from their inputs on unsafe or sensitive content without disclosing the modification, a failure mode we call alignment-induced unfaithfulness (AIU). Unlike capability-driven unfaithfulness, which comes from errors in knowledge or reasoning, this is induced by post-training mechanisms that override adherence to the input. We introduce FaithConflict, a controlled dataset isolating both conflicts, and two complementary taxonomies: behavioral (B1-B8) and chain-of-thought reasoning (C0-C6). Across models, AIU increases with scale and more sharply than capability-driven unfaithfulness, a reverse scaling law; intermediate checkpoints show it is amplified during post-training, with DPO the stage at which the gap both grows most and becomes least visible.
