Experiments across three LLMs show that Acmite effectively mitigates gender bias across complementary evaluation formats while maintaining competitive performance on bias-unrelated tasks. Anonymous code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Acmite-18E2/.

</details>


### [268] [Task-Oriented Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning in Text Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01702)
*Rey Sanchez Lopez,Eduardo Morales Manzanares,Hugo Jair Escalante*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出TORA，一种基于LoRA低秩结构几何路由的持续学习框架，通过结构相似度决定知识迁移或任务隔离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本分类的持续学习面临灾难性遗忘与跨任务负迁移两大挑战。LoRA等PEFT方法虽能高效适配，但其低秩表示通常被孤立训练，难以在相关任务间复用，导致知识无法有效迁移。

Method: TORA（Task-Oriented Rank Adaptation），一个几何路由框架。它利用LoRA适配器的低秩结构，基于结构相似度判断：若新任务与最兼容的专家结构相似则进行知识迁移（Boosting），否则隔离新任务（Shielding）。仅使用单一几何阈值，不依赖任务身份或预定义序列顺序。

Result: 在15个多样化文本分类基准上评估，TORA始终避免有害的路由决策：兼容任务在减少训练时间的同时超越其孤立性能；结构上相距较远的任务则免受干扰且无精度损失。

Conclusion: TORA为序贯文本分类系统中的动态适配器路由提供了一种简单而有效的方法，实现了兼容任务的知识复用与远距任务的隔离保护。

Abstract: Continual learning (CL) in text classification faces two critical challenges: catastrophic forgetting and negative transfer across sequential tasks. Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods such as LoRA enable efficient adaptation by learning low-rank updates of the model parameters. However, these compact representations are normally trained in isolation, limiting their reuse across related tasks. We introduce Task-Oriented Rank Adaptation (TORA), a geometric routing framework that leverages the low-rank structure of LoRA adapters to decide whether to transfer knowledge from the most compatible expert (Boosting) or isolate the new task (Shielding) based on structural similarity. Evaluated across 15 diverse text classification benchmarks, TORA consistently avoids harmful routing decisions: compatible tasks exceed their isolated performance while reducing training time, and structurally distant tasks are protected from interference with no loss in accuracy. With a single geometric threshold and no reliance on task identities or predefined sequences, TORA provides a simple and effective approach for dynamic adapter routing in sequential text classification systems.

</details>


### [269] [A Matryoshka Hierarchical RAG for Efficient Multi-Hop Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01767)
*Gianluca Bonifazi,Christopher Buratti,Michele Marchetti,Federica Parlapiano,Giulia Quaglieri,Davide Traini,Domenico Ursino,Luca Virgili*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MatRAG将RAG与Matryoshka表示学习结合，通过层次化聚类DAG与嵌套维度对齐，在多跳QA中兼顾检索质量并降低索引与查询成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多跳问答的RAG系统需要在检索质量与计算成本之间权衡：索引阶段构建知识图谱或使用大模型生成摘要代价高昂，查询阶段迭代式LLM驱动检索同样开销大。因此需要一种在保持检索质量的同时降低这两类成本的方法。

Method: 提出MatRAG层次化框架，将RAG与Matryoshka表示学习（MRL）结合。方法把文档语料组织为粒度逐级变粗的聚类有向无环图（DAG），每一层用更低的Matryoshka维度建立索引，使聚类结构的语义层次与MRL的嵌套结构对齐；查询时采用自顶向下的迭代遍历，并配合实体驱动机制控制跳数预算与候选重排序。

Result: 在三个标准多跳QA基准上与七个代表性基线对比，MatRAG在检索质量上优于最强竞争方法；同时通过避免知识图谱构建与LLM摘要降低索引成本，并借助维度感知的相似度计算降低查询时开销。

Conclusion: 将层次化聚类结构与Matryoshka嵌套表示对齐，可有效协调多跳QA中检索质量与计算成本之间的矛盾，在提升检索效果的同时显著降低索引和查询成本。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems for multi-hop Question Answering (QA) must balance retrieval quality with computational cost. This cost is incurred during indexing time, through the use of expensive Knowledge Graphs (KGs) or Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate summaries, or during querying, through iterative LLM-driven retrieval. To reduce it while maintaining retrieval quality, we present MatRAG, a hierarchical framework that combines RAG systems with Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL). MatRAG addresses both kinds of cost by aligning the semantic hierarchy of a clustering structure with the nested structure of MRL. Specifically, it organizes the corpus of documents into a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) of clusters with progressively coarser granularity. Each level is indexed by a lower Matryoshka dimension. MatRAG pairs an iterative, top-down traversal of the DAG with an entity-driven mechanism that controls the hop budget and re-ranks candidates. We evaluated MatRAG on three standard multi-hop QA benchmarks against seven representative baselines. MatRAG outperforms its strongest competitors in terms of retrieval quality; furthermore, it reduces indexing costs by avoiding KG construction and LLM-based summarization, and lowers query-time costs through dimension-aware similarity.

</details>


### [270] [The Asymptotics of Language Model Alignment with Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01828)
*Haricharan Balasundaram,V. Arvind Rameshwar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文将 KL 约束 RL 与 best-of-n 两种对齐方法之间渐近分布接近的结论，从独立同分布 token 序列推广到马尔可夫 token 序列，并对有限长度（尤其 m=1）情形给出 KL 散度为零的 LM 分布与奖励函数的完整刻画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LM 对齐旨在将给定 LM Q 扰动为对齐 LM q，使 q 与 Q 的输出分布在概率上接近且 q 具有更高期望奖励。KL 约束 RL 需已知 LM 分布且计算昂贵，best-of-n 仅需从 LM 采样。Yang 等已证明在 m 长度独立同分布 token 序列、m→∞ 时两种方法分布渐近接近，但独立同分布假设不符合实际 LM（输出序列常具有记忆性）。

Method: 将输出 token 序列建模为马尔可夫序列，把 Yang 等的渐近接近性结果推广到该情形；针对有限长度输出序列，特别是 m=1，对使两种对齐方法产生分布之间 KL 散度为零的 LM 分布与奖励函数进行完整刻画。

Result: 在马尔可夫 token 序列下，两种对齐方法所产生分布的渐近接近性成立；并在有限长度（尤其 m=1）情形下，完整刻画了使两分布 KL 散度为零的 LM 分布与奖励函数，回答了 Yang 等提出的问题。

Conclusion: 本文放宽了独立同分布假设这一不切实际的限制，将 KL 约束 RL 与 best-of-n 的渐近等价性扩展到具有记忆性的马尔可夫序列，并补充了有限长度下的精确刻画，深化了对两种对齐方法关系的理论理解。

Abstract: Language model (LM) alignment broadly aims to perturb a given LM $Q$ into an aligned LM $q$ such that i) the outputs produced by $q$ and $Q$ are 'close' in probability, ii) $q$ has a higher expected reward than $Q$. Two common techniques for LM alignment are: KL-constrained RL, which requires knowledge of the LM distribution and is computationally expensive, and the best-of-$n$ algorithm, which requires only sampling from the LM. The work of Yang et al. established asymptotic closeness between the distributions produced by the two alignment methods for an $m$--length i.i.d. token sequence output by the LM, in the limit as $m$ increases to infinity. However, the i.i.d. assumption is not representative of practical LMs, whose output sequences often have memory. In this paper, we extend the asymptotic closeness result to the case when the $m$--length token sequence outputted by the LM is Markovian. Further, for finite-length output sequences -- particularly, when $m=1$ -- we provide a complete characterization of LM distributions and reward functions for which the KL-divergence between the distributions produced by the two alignment methods is zero -- a question first posed in Yang et al.

</details>


### [271] [Cross-Lingual Alignment for Decoder-Only Models using MoE Routers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01921)
*Lucas Bandarkar,Clark Peng,Ahmed Haj Ahmed,Aditi Khandelwal,Nanyun Peng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出对MoE路由器输出进行跨语言对比对齐的损失，使解码器-only LLM在不依赖隐状态对齐的情况下实现跨语言表示对齐，并提升多语言性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解码器-only LLM因多语言分词不一致，难以像多语言编码器那样直接对隐状态施加跨语言对比对齐损失；但已有研究表明更强的跨语言表示对齐可提升跨语言迁移能力。

Method: 不做隐状态上的辅助对齐损失，而是以MoE路由器输出作为对齐目标，利用其在多token上更易池化的特性，在序列级进行跨语言对比学习；在四个开源MoE模型上开展受控持续预训练实验。

Result: 引入该路由损失后，底层隐表示也随之跨语言对齐；并且在多样化评测集上提升了多语言表现。

Conclusion: 跨语言MoE路由器对齐是一种在现代LLM架构约束下可行且有效的对比学习替代方案，具有提升多语言能力的潜力。

Abstract: Cross-lingual contrastive learning has been a core component of multilingual encoder training, but the ability to explicitly align representations is not possible in decoder-only LLMs because of varying multilingual tokenization. However, a growing amount of research suggests that even in LLMs, higher cross-lingual representational alignment leads to improved cross-lingual transfer. In this paper, we propose a novel approach to reimagine cross-lingual contrastive learning given the architectural constraints of modern LLMs. Rather than applying an auxiliary alignment loss on hidden states, we propose using the outputs of the mixture-of-experts (MoE) routers as the target for alignment. Router outputs lend themselves better to pooling over many tokens, enabling more reliable cross-lingual comparisons at the sequence-level. Controlled continual pre-training experiments on four open-source MoEs show that incorporating this routing loss also aligns the underlying hidden representations across languages. Most importantly, this loss improves multilingual performance on our diverse evaluation suite, demonstrating the potential of cross-lingual MoE router alignment.

</details>


### [272] [A rubric landscape for evaluating clinical reasoning in large language models: what exists, what is missing, and what needs to be combined](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01938)
*Zhangshu Joshua Jiang,Zina Ibrahim,James T. Teo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 考试式准确率无法证明LLM在临床记录上的推理能力。本文通过结构化叙述性综述，梳理医学教育评估工具、2023年以来的临床LLM基准及长文本生成评估方法三类文献，围绕六个维度进行评估，指出现有工具均有缺口，并提出组合式评估设计思路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多以考试式准确率衡量LLM的临床能力，但这并不能反映模型是否能在临床记录上随时间与来源整合、更新证据，形成并修正患者问题表征与可辩护的诊疗计划。因此需要系统梳理可评估临床推理的现有工具与方法，识别覆盖缺口。

Method: 采用结构化叙述性综述，映射三类文献：（1）医学教育评估工具；（2）2023年及以后发表的临床LLM基准；（3）通用领域长文本生成评估方法。从六个维度进行考察：问题表征、时间综合、鉴别与管理推理、反事实推理、校准不确定性、推理忠实性。纳入预印本并予以标注。

Result: 没有任何单一工具能覆盖全部六个维度。问题表征与鉴别/管理推理覆盖较好，但信度因工具与场景而异；TIMER-Eval针对时间综合，ER-Reason评估序列化诊断信念更新；不确定性与反事实评估正在兴起，但对纵向自由文本推理的适用性有限；事实完整性在通用领域评估中理论较成熟，临床早期证据显示存在重要遗漏；忠实性是最薄弱维度，仅识别出一项针对多选题的临床因果消融研究。

Conclusion: 建议通过二元评分项、完整性与正确性分开计分、病例特异重要性加权并设不可补偿的安全上限、时间顺序一致性检查以及机会校正的信度报告来组合现有工具。校准不确定性、反事实推理与纵向自由文本记录的忠实性仍需进一步设计研究。本综述提供的是设计依据，而非经过验证的评估工具。

Abstract: Exam-style accuracy does not establish whether large language models (LLMs) reason well over clinical records. We define clinical reasoning as integrating and updating evidence across time and sources to form, revise and justify a patient's problem representation and a defensible plan.
  This structured narrative review maps three literatures: medical education assessment instruments, clinical LLM benchmarks published from 2023 onwards, and general-domain methods for evaluating long-form generation. We examine six dimensions: problem representation, temporal synthesis, differential and management reasoning, counterfactual reasoning, calibrated uncertainty, and reasoning faithfulness. Preprints are included and flagged.
  No single instrument covers all six dimensions. Problem representation and differential or management reasoning are reasonably covered, although reliability varies by instrument and setting. TIMER-Eval targets temporal synthesis, and ER-Reason assesses sequential diagnostic belief updating. Dedicated uncertainty and counterfactual evaluations are emerging, but their applicability to longitudinal free-text reasoning remains limited. Factual completeness is well theorised in general-domain evaluation, with early clinical evidence of important omissions. Faithfulness remains the weakest dimension, with one identified clinical causal-ablation study on multiple-choice questions.
  Existing tools should be combined through binary rubric items, separate completeness and correctness scores, case-specific importance weighting with non-compensable safety caps, temporal order-consistency checks, and chance-corrected reliability reporting. Further design work is needed for calibrated uncertainty, counterfactual reasoning and faithfulness over longitudinal free-text records. This review provides a design rationale, not a validated instrument.

</details>


### [273] [Universal Byte-Level Encoding: UTF-8/UTF-16 Routing to Reduce Cross-Script Token-Budget Disparities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01984)
*Hyunsik Kim,Youngmoon Jung*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 UBE 双字母表分词器，将 1-2 字节 UTF-8 字符保留在 UTF-8 路径、3-4 字节字符改走 UTF-16，从而降低高溢价脚本的编码下限，同时不增加英语等高效区间的成本，并保持标准 BPE 合并规则与精确解码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 字节级 BPE（BBPE）分词器因覆盖全部 Unicode 文本而对多语言大模型有吸引力。但在基于 UTF-8 的 BBPE 中，当无法应用已学到的合并规则时，多字节字符需由多个字节派生符号表示，导致许多脚本的"最坏情况预合并成本"（即编码下限）高于英语。较高的编码下限会推高 token 数与单次请求成本，并压缩可用上下文。更换文本编码可缩小差距，但单一全局编码又可能使混合脚本文本中原本高效的英语片段变贵。

Method: UBE 是一种双字母表分词器：1-2 字节的 UTF-8 字符继续走 UTF-8 路径，3-4 字节的 UTF-8 字符改由 UTF-16 表示。它仅改变呈现给 BPE 的字节表示，合并规则仍为标准 BPE，精确解码得以保留；并可与其他边界策略及基于形态学的表示方式组合。该方法降低了带高 token 溢价（相对英语的 token 数比）脚本中 3 字节 BMP 字符的编码下限，且不抬高混合脚本文本中本就高效片段的成本。

Result: 在 Unicode 17 审计中，UBE 对所有 Unicode 标量值以及官方 normalization、grapheme-break、emoji 测试套件中的全部输入均能精确往返。在内在评测中，UBE 降低了英语归一化 token 数比值的离散度，缩小了跨语言 token 预算差距。在多语言语言模型实验中，UBE 的 LM 质量与 BBPE 相当；在主要多语言设置下，UBE 对高溢价脚本的 token 数削减最多，并略微降低英语 token 数，从而在固定 token 预算下获得更多可用上下文，并在内容匹配基准上加快提示处理。

Conclusion: UBE 通过双字母表编码路径在不牺牲英语等高效区间的前提下降低多语言脚本的编码下限，实现无损往返、与 BBPE 相当的 LM 质量，并提升固定预算下的上下文可用性与处理速度。

Abstract: Byte-level byte-pair encoding (BBPE) tokenizers are attractive for multilingual large language models (LLMs) because they cover all Unicode text. In UTF-8-based BBPE, however, many scripts start from a higher fallback cost than English: when no learned merges can be applied, a multibyte character requires multiple byte-derived symbols. We call this worst-case pre-merge cost the encoding floor. A higher floor can increase token counts and per-request cost and shrink usable context. Changing the text encoding can reduce this gap, but a single global encoding can make already-efficient English spans more expensive in mixed-script text. We propose Universal Byte-Level Encoding (UBE), a dual-alphabet tokenizer that keeps 1-2-byte UTF-8 characters on the UTF-8 path while routing 3-4-byte UTF-8 characters through UTF-16. This lowers the encoding floor for 3-byte Basic Multilingual Plane (BMP) characters in scripts with high token premiums (token counts relative to English) without raising it for already-efficient spans in mixed-script text. UBE changes only the byte representation presented to byte-pair encoding (BPE); the merge rule remains standard, and exact decoding is preserved. UBE also composes with alternative boundary policies and morphology-based representations. In a Unicode 17 audit, UBE exactly round-trips all Unicode scalar values and all inputs in the official normalization, grapheme-break, and emoji test suites. Across intrinsic evaluations, UBE lowers dispersion in English-normalized token-count ratios, reducing cross-lingual token-budget disparity. In multilingual language model (LM) experiments, UBE matches BBPE's LM quality. In the main multilingual settings, UBE reduces token counts most for high-premium scripts and slightly lowers English token counts, yielding more usable context under fixed token budgets and faster prompt processing in content-matched benchmarks.

</details>


### [274] [Mem++: Non-Destructive Memory for Long-Term Organizational LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02002)
*Ahmad Yehia,Aly O. Abdelkareem,Islam Ahmed,Hesham Omran,Khaled Alashmouny,Christian Claudel,Abduallah Mohamed*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Mem++ 是一种非破坏性记忆框架，将写入时蒸馏转为读取时选择：完整存储每份文档及其日期与作者，读取时仅检索问题时间点之前的文档并融合词法与语义排序，在 OrgMemBench、LoCoMo、LongMemEval-S 上均取得领先结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体参与组织工作，决策以新文档而非编辑形式出现，回答问题时需知道某时间点生效的版本。但多数记忆系统在写入时压缩记录（蒸馏为事实、笔记或图边），提前固定了可回答的内容，导致时间敏感的版本问题难以处理。

Method: 提出 Mem++，从写入时蒸馏转向读取时选择。写入阶段不调用生成模型，原样保存每份文档及其日期与作者；读取阶段仅检索日期不晚于问题所问时间点的文档，并融合词法排序与语义排序。系统不覆盖旧版本，而是保留全部版本，把版本选择权交由回答模型。

Result: 在组织场景基准 OrgMemBench 上，两种回答模型下均超过最强记忆系统基线 8.0 至 13.1 分；使用 gpt-4.1-mini 时取得最佳总体分数，高于 RAG 2.6 分。在 LoCoMo 上获得最佳 LLM 评判平均分，在 LongMemEval-S 上排名第二，仅次于其实体图变体。

Conclusion: 保留完整、带时间戳的文档并将选择推迟到读取阶段，能有效提升时间敏感的组织记忆问答性能，优于写入时压缩与覆盖式更新的记忆方案。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents now take part in organizational work, where many authors record decisions across documents over months. Because a revised decision arrives as a new document rather than an edit, answering a question requires knowing which version held at a given time. However, most memory systems compress the record at write time. By distilling each document into facts, notes or graph edges, these methods fix what can be answered before any question is asked. To address this, we propose Mem++, a non-destructive memory framework shifting from write-time distillation to read-time selection. Mem++ stores every document whole with its date and author, and it calls no generative model at write time. At read time, it retrieves only documents dated up to the time a question asks about and fuses lexical and semantic rankings. Unlike systems that overwrite older versions, Mem++ keeps them and leaves the choice to the answering model. Evaluations on the organizational benchmark OrgMemBench demonstrate that Mem++ surpasses the strongest memory system baseline by 8.0 to 13.1 points across two answering models. With gpt-4.1-mini, it also achieves the best overall score, 2.6 points above RAG. In addition, Mem++ achieves the best average LLM-judge score on LoCoMo and ranks second on LongMemEval-S, behind only its entity-graph variant. Code for benchmark evaluation is available at https://github.com/AIDAChip-Inc/mem-plus-plus.

</details>


### [275] [Controllable Multi-label Video Safety Detection via Adaptive Tversky Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02019)
*Guangyu Yang,Jingbiao Mei,Mingsheng Sun,Jinghong Chen,Yingtong Bu,Pengda Qin,Da Chen,Bill Byrne*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出自适应Tversky策略优化（ATPO），一个用于多标签视频安全检测（Multi-VSD）的强化学习框架，通过自适应Tversky奖励（ATR）动态调整误报与漏报惩罚，实现可控的精确率-召回率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频社交媒体使有害内容暴露增加，需要可靠的自动化视频安全检测。现有VLM有害视频检测系统存在两大局限：一是将安全检测简化为二分类，忽视了不安全视频固有的多标签特性；二是依赖静态训练目标，无法支持可控的精确率-召回率权衡，而不同审核流程和不安全类别所需的工作点可能不同。

Method: 提出自适应Tversky策略优化（ATPO），一种面向多标签视频安全检测的强化学习框架。其中引入自适应Tversky奖励（ATR），在训练过程中动态调整误报与漏报惩罚，从而实现可控的精确率-召回率权衡。

Result: 在SafeWatch-Bench和XD-Violence上，ATPO大幅提升多标签性能，将SafeWatch-Bench-Real上的Jaccard Index从40.66提升至75.44。此外，ATR能够可靠地引导精确率-召回率工作点，支持具有异构策略需求的部署场景。

Conclusion: ATPO通过强化学习与自适应奖励机制有效解决了多标签视频安全检测及精确率-召回率可控权衡的问题，为不同审核策略下的部署提供了灵活性。代码与检查点已公开。

Abstract: The rapid growth of video-based social media has increased users' exposure to harmful content, creating a need for reliable automated video safety detection. Although recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show strong video understanding capabilities, existing harmful video detection systems face two key limitations: they typically reduce safety detection to binary classification, overlooking the inherently multi-label nature of unsafe videos, and they rely on static training objectives that do not support controllable precision-recall trade-offs, though the desired operating point may vary across moderation pipelines and unsafe categories. To address these gaps, we propose Adaptive Tversky Policy Optimization (ATPO), a reinforcement learning framework for Multi-label Video Safety Detection (Multi-VSD). ATPO introduces the Adaptive Tversky Reward (ATR), which dynamically adjusts false-positive and false-negative penalties during training to enable controllable precision-recall trade-offs. Experiments on SafeWatch-Bench and XD-Violence show that ATPO substantially improves multi-label performance, increasing the Jaccard Index from 40.66 to 75.44 on SafeWatch-Bench-Real. Moreover, ATR enables reliable steering of the precision-recall operating point, supporting deployment scenarios with heterogeneous policy requirements. Code and checkpoints are provided at https://bruceyg.github.io/ATPO-project-page/ .

</details>


### [276] [Old Ideas, Novel Problems: The Instability of LLM-Based Novelty Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02022)
*Noy Sternlicht,Simra Shahid,Peter Jansen,Daniel S. Weld,Pao Siangliulue,Tom Hope*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文通过受控实验系统检验了LLM新颖性评审器的可靠性，发现提示设计的微小变化会导致判定结果剧烈波动，效率增益有限，专用评审器甚至不如最简单的提示基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化创意生成系统常以"新颖性"作为评价指标，而该判断越来越多被委托给大语言模型。然而这类评审器通常是临时搭建的，且（即便有）也多在人类撰写的论文上验证，而非在其真正需要打分的生成式创意上验证。因此作者追问：这些新颖性评审器究竟表现如何？

Method: 作者开展了一项关于新颖性评估设计选择的系统性受控研究。首先自动构建评测集：从OpenReview中挖掘评审人明确肯定或质疑论文原创性的文本片段，仅保留在其研究领域两端获得一致意见的投稿，并将其与来自普通LLM生成器的创意配对。随后在六种评审器上测试不同提示设计与推理配置的影响。

Result: 微小的提示设计选择会带来巨大后果。例如，仅告知评审器"评审人认为其中一个创意新颖、另一个不新颖"，就能让其对被展示的同一创意对中超过半数的判定发生改变，使成对准确率波动超过50个百分点，有时甚至低于随机水平。同样的改动对某一评审器有帮助、对另一评审器却有害；检索增强和更大的推理预算帮助甚微；两个专门构建的新颖性评估器被最廉价的提示基线所超越。

Conclusion: 研究结果对自动化创意生成系统所报告的新颖性增益提出质疑，并呼吁建立更稳健的新颖性评估方法。

Abstract: Automated ideation systems are often evaluated on the novelty of the ideas they produce, and that judgment is increasingly delegated to large language models. Such judges are typically built ad hoc and validated, if at all, on human-authored papers rather than on the generated ideas they are meant to score. So, how do novelty judges perform?
  Not well. We present a systematic controlled study of novelty evaluation design choices. We first build an evaluation set automatically, mining OpenReview for passages where reviewers explicitly affirm or dispute a paper's originality and keeping only submissions with unanimous agreement at the extremes of their research area; we pair these with ideas from a vanilla LLM generator. Across six judges, we find that small prompt design choices have large consequences; e.g., simply telling the judge that reviewers found one idea novel and the other not can change its verdict on more than half of the identical idea pairs it is shown, shifting pairwise accuracy by over 50 points and occasionally pushing it below chance. The same change helps one judge and hurts another. Retrieval and larger reasoning budgets help little, and two purpose-built novelty evaluators are outperformed by our cheapest prompted baseline. These results raise questions about reported novelty gains of automated ideation systems, and call for robust novelty evaluation methods.

</details>


### [277] [Typological Alignment of Stack-Based Language Models on Mildly Context-Sensitive Artificial Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02040)
*Nadine El-Naggar,Tatsuki Kuribayashi,Ted Briscoe*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过跨序列依赖与栈式语言模型(SLM)的仿真，扩展了语言模型学习偏置与语言类型学共性之间关系的分析，发现有限工作记忆的SLM泛化更好，为某些语序共性的归纳偏置提供了可能基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言类型学共性（如SOV语序更普遍）常被归因于学习偏置，近期借助语言模型的仿真推动了该理论探索。本文旨在从数据与模型两个方面扩展这一分析，聚焦于跨序列依赖（已知句法复杂度的上限）及可能促进层级模式学习的栈式语言模型。

Method: 在多种人工语言上评估栈式语言模型（SLM）对跨序列依赖的泛化能力，并对比工作记忆受限的SLM与常规SLM的表现。

Result: SLM在跨序列依赖上泛化困难，难以掌握该类结构；但工作记忆受限的SLM泛化能力反而更强。

Conclusion: 工作记忆受限带来的归纳偏置可能为某些语序配置的类型学共性提供基础，支持学习偏置解释语言类型学共性的理论。

Abstract: Some properties of languages, e.g., subject-object-verb (SOV) word order, are more prevalent than others among the thousands of attested natural languages (NLs). Such typological commonality is often attributed to learning biases. Computational simulations, recently with language models (LMs), have facilitated the exploration of this theory. In this paper, we extend existing analyses of the relationship between LMs' learning biases and typological commonality on both data and model sides, focusing on: (i) cross-serial dependencies, the upper limit of attested syntactic complexity, and (ii) stack-based LMs (SLMs), potentially facilitating learning of hierarchical patterns. We first evaluate generalization of SLMs on cross-serial dependencies across diverse artificial languages and confirm that they struggle with such constructions. However, SLMs with limited working memory generalize better suggesting a possible basis for such inductive bias and thus the typological commonality of some word order configurations.

</details>


### [278] [LLM2Jev: LLMs Are Already Jev-Style Decision Models -- When and How to Fine-Tune Them](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02076)
*Yinheng Li,Justin Wagle*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出LLM2Jev框架，从LLM下一token概率中直接抽取标定决策，兼顾免训练推理与微调目标；实验表明现代LLM本身即为有效决策模型，微调仅在弱模型和特定任务上带来针对性收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Jev式决策模型仅输出预定义选项上的类别概率分布、不生成自由文本，便于软件系统直接消费其输出。作者希望探究通用LLM是否开箱即具备该能力，以及何时才真正需要微调。

Method: LLM2Jev为保持架构不变的框架，通过带括号数字标识符上的下一token概率直接抽取标定决策。它同时提供免训练推理配方与微调目标：微调采用树因子化listwise损失优化候选选择，并用KL散度惩罚将辅助预测锚定到基座模型。

Result: 在Qwen3.5-4B与Qwen3-0.6B上评测：免训练时4B模型即比肩同骨干的社区Jev式模型，优于字母logit读出，支持任意选项数，并原生处理图像多模态决策。微调带来的是针对性而非普适收益——显著提升弱模型及特定任务（如多选项意图路由），对强骨干收益递减。KL锚可防止对话文本生成的行为退化，LoRA在强模型上表现最佳。

Conclusion: 现代LLM本质上已是有效决策模型，微调并非普遍必需；LLM2Jev在保持架构不变的前提下实现标定决策抽取，并通过KL锚定与LoRA在提升决策能力的同时避免生成行为退化。

Abstract: Jev-style decision models return categorical probability distributions over predefined options without generating free-form text, enabling software systems to act on their outputs directly. In this work, we investigate the extent to which general-purpose LLMs already possess this capability out of the box, and when fine-tuning is actually necessary. We present LLM2Jev, an architecture-preserving framework that extracts calibrated decisions directly from next-token probabilities over bracketed numeric identifiers. LLM2Jev provides both a training-free inference recipe and a fine-tuning objective that optimizes candidate selection via a tree-factorized listwise loss while anchoring auxiliary predictions to the base model using KL divergence penalties. Evaluating on Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3-0.6B, we find that modern LLMs are inherently effective decision models: without training, the 4B model matches community Jev-style models built on the same backbone, outperforms letter-logit readouts, supports arbitrary option counts, and natively handles multimodal decisions over images. Fine-tuning provides targeted rather than universal benefits -- substantially improving weaker models and specific tasks (such as many-option intent routing), but offering diminishing returns for strong backbones. Crucially, our KL anchors prevent behavioral degradation in conversational text generation, with LoRA delivering the strongest performance on capable models.

</details>


### [279] [Scalable, Transferable Meta-network for Data Selection Requires a Different Loss (and Why the Obvious Choice is Problematic)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02092)
*Zilin Du,Bowen Yang,Boyang Albert Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出TESS数据选择框架，通过Pointwise Value Matching目标训练选择网络，解决MTS中权重抑制与依赖易学特征导致的优化不稳定与泛化差问题，实现跨数据集、跨规模迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在超大规模异构语料上训练大语言模型时，数据选择至关重要。元学习式训练数据选择（MTS）虽能从目标验证目标中学习数据权重，优于启发式打分，但现有方法在细粒度估值与对未见数据的可迁移性之间存在权衡。用选择网络替代逐样本权重是自然的解决思路，但直接将其嵌入现有MTS目标会因权重抑制和持续依赖易学特征而导致优化不稳定、泛化差。

Method: 提出TESS（Transferable Example Scoring and Selection），一个可扩展的数据选择框架，核心是Pointwise Value Matching（PVM）目标，用于训练选择网络以替代逐样本权重，从而缓解权重抑制与对易学特征的依赖问题。

Result: 在LLM安全与定向指令微调任务上进行实验，展现出强迁移能力：从子集到全语料、从较小模型到较大模型均可迁移。

Conclusion: TESS通过PVM目标有效克服了将选择网络引入MTS的优化与泛化障碍，为大规模语料训练提供了兼具细粒度与可迁移性的数据选择方案。

Abstract: Data selection is critical for training large language models on massive and heterogeneous corpora. Meta-learning for Training-data Selection offers a principled alternative to heuristic scoring by learning data weights from a target validation objective, but existing methods face a trade-off between fine-grained valuation and transferability to unseen data. A natural solution is to replace per-sample weights with a selection network. However, we find that directly incorporating such a network into existing MTS objectives leads to unstable optimization and poor generalization, caused by weight suppression and persistent reliance on easy-to-learn features. To address these issues, we propose Transferable Example Scoring and Selection (TESS), a scalable data-selection framework built on a Pointwise Value Matching objective (PVM). Experiments on LLM safety and targeted instruction tuning demonstrate strong transfer across datasets, from subsets to full corpora, and from smaller to larger models.

</details>


### [280] [Argo-Bench: Evaluating Data Agents on Enterprise-Scale Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02122)
*Gabriel Tomitsuka,Arman Raayatsanati,Emma Xing,Duke Gand,Joseph J Ma*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Argo-Bench：基于模拟真实企业数据仓库的210项数据科学与分析任务评测框架，要求智能体跨表推理并执行动作，考察其后果而非仅SQL生成，最强模型仅34.8%任务达95分以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有text-to-SQL基准仅评估查询生成，且答案键常被审计发现有误；而真实企业数据仓库因敏感无法公开，公开数据集业务事件又多局限于单表，无法反映跨数十张表推理、统计分析与行动的真实工作流需求。

Method: 构建Argo-Bench评测框架，含210项数据科学与分析任务。基于公开数据、行业同行评审文献与监管文件，模拟纽约市食品配送平台：2024年8100万订单，含贴合实际的经济模型、欺诈模式与市场激励机制；导出为235张表、75亿行的ERP仓库，仿Oracle E-Business Suite模式。模拟器真值状态对智能体可见仓库隐藏，任务需先导航仓库重建事实再行动。任务超越text-to-SQL，包含封禁欺诈账户、分配骑手激励预算、补发薪资等动作，评分器按模拟器中的后果打分。每项任务配有可执行参考解，证明仅用仓库即可求解。

Result: 14个前沿与开源权重模型中表现最强者，仅在34.8%的任务上得分达到95分及以上，平均得分59.5分。

Conclusion: Argo-Bench有望推动智能体向理解、导航并在真实数据环境中行动的方向发展。

Abstract: Real-world enterprise data science and analytics workflows require reasoning across dozens of tables, performing statistical analyses, and acting on the results. Established text-to-SQL benchmarks evaluate query generation alone, and audits have found their answer keys frequently wrong. Because real enterprise warehouses are too sensitive to release, these benchmarks are built on public datasets where a business event fits in a single table. We introduce Argo-Bench, an evaluation framework comprising 210 data science and analytics tasks. Drawing on public data, peer-reviewed industry literature, and regulatory filings, we simulate a food delivery platform in New York City at true scale, with 81 million orders in 2024, grounded economics, fraud patterns, and marketplace incentives. We export this world to an ERP warehouse of 235 tables and 7.5 billion rows, modeled on the Oracle E-Business Suite schema. The simulator's ground-truth state is withheld from the warehouse the agent sees, so tasks require reconstructing facts by navigating the warehouse before acting on them. Argo-Bench goes beyond text-to-SQL: the agent files actions such as banning fraudulent accounts, allocating courier incentive budgets, or issuing back pay, and the grader scores each by its consequences in the simulator. Every task has an executable reference solution that demonstrates solvability using only the warehouse. The strongest of 14 frontier and open-weight models scores 95 or higher on only 34.8% of tasks and averages 59.5 points. We hope Argo-Bench drives progress toward agents that understand, navigate, and act within real data environments.

</details>


### [281] [Keyword Harnesses Fail Open: A Cheap Diagnostic Ladder for Tool-Use Claims in Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02142)
*Juan S. Santillana*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 关键词匹配式工具使用评测会让小模型"虚假得分"。作者在配对架构的西班牙语安全模型中发现此假阳性：600M 模型与 1B 模型宽松指标几乎相同，但严格复现检验下 600M 为 6/6 正确、1B 为 0/6。定位故障为首 token 先验缺失，并用低成本定向 SFT 修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具调用（tool use）基准多依赖关键词匹配，可能给从未真正执行工具调用的模型记分，造成假阳性。作者需要一套严格且低成本的诊断方法，来甄别"格式像"与"功能真"的差异。

Method: 选取共享解码器、分词器与特殊 token 的配对模型：661.6M 参数模型（约 65% 代码/技术文本、无专门 SFT）与 1,109M 模型（网页为主的多次课程训练 + 6B token 工具 SFT）。提出"诊断阶梯"：(1) 训练样本逐字复现检验；(2) 首 token 探针定位缺失先验；(3) 定向 SFT 修复（多样语料、学习率提高 5 倍、2,202 步、约 3.3 GPU 小时）；(4) 嵌入漂移检查；(5) 因子分析检验各修复配置的贡献。

Result: 宽松指标下 B4 得分接近（0.660 vs. 0.650）；逐字复现检验完全区分：600M 在 6/6 样本上输出带泛化参数的有效调用，1B 跨检查点为 0/6。首 token 探针显示 1B 在 <|tool_call|> 上概率仅 10^-4–10^-5，该先验被网页为主的训练阶段抹除。定向 SFT 使 1B 在全部 269 行有效输出率由 0.100 升至 0.959（600M 为 0.926）；238 条未见提示上修复后 1B 通过率 0.536，高于 600M 的 0.428（p = 0.004）。嵌入漂移检查显示触发 token 的绑定嵌入未移动，97.7% 的 bf16 权重表仍逐位相同，说明修复发生在周边网络。两模型均存在过度触发：负面提示下不调用工具的比例 600M 为 0.09、修复后 1B 为 0.17。因子分析确认各修复配置都能植入格式，但多样语料对"抑制过度触发"的收益因种子敏感性仍属假设。

Conclusion: 关键词匹配指标不足以支撑小模型的工具使用主张；本文提出的诊断阶梯仅需数分钟 CPU 时间，可作为低成本门控（gate）流程，用于验证小模型工具调用能力声明，并揭示"格式合规"与"功能可用"之间的关键差距。

Abstract: Keyword-matching benchmarks can credit small models for tool use they never perform. We document such a false positive in a matched-architecture pair of Spanish security language models and propose a ladder of strict, cheap diagnostics. A 661.6M parameter model (approx. 65% code/technical text; no dedicated SFT) and a 1,109M model (web-heavy multi-phase curriculum; 6B-token tool-SFT) share decoder, tokenizer, and special tokens, scoring almost identically on lenient tool-use metrics (B4: 0.660 vs. 0.650).
  Verbatim-reproduction checks on training examples separate them completely: the 600M emits valid tool calls with generalized arguments on 6/6 examples; the 1B does so on 0/6 across checkpoints. A first-token probe localizes the 1B's failure to a missing prior (prob. $10^{-4}$--$10^{-5}$ on <|tool_call|>), which was erased by its web-heavy training phase. A targeted SFT recipe (diverse corpus, 5x higher learning rate, 2,202 steps, ~3.3 GPU-hours) repairs the 1B using three orders of magnitude fewer tokens than the failed phase. On all 269 corpus rows, valid emission rises from 0.100 to 0.959 (600M: 0.926). On 238 unseen prompts, the repaired 1B passes 0.536 vs. the 600M's 0.428 ($p = 0.004$). Embedding-drift checks show the repair did not move the trigger token's tied embedding (97.7% of the bf16 table remains bit-identical), meaning changes live in the surrounding network.
  Both models over-trigger, rarely answering negative prompts without a call (0.09 for 600M, 0.17 for repaired 1B). Factorial analyses confirm all repair configurations install the format, though suppression benefits from a diverse corpus remain a hypothesis due to seed sensitivity. This cheap diagnostic ladder costs minutes of CPU time and should gate tool-use claims on small models.

</details>


### [282] [From Knowledge Access to Source Learning: Developing Source-Specific Competence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02150)
*Lucheng Fu,Kejing Xia,Yiyang Wang,Yiqiao Jin,Jinjin He,Xiyuan Yang,Haoxin Liu,Ye Yu,Haibo Jin,Yijia Xiao,Wenke Lee,B. Aditya Prakash,Haohan Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出"源学习"(source learning)任务与持久化"源模型"(source model)，并设计 SourceLearn，通过自导向与任务导向两种学习机制逐步精炼对权威外部源的复用性理解，在五个基准、三种LLM后端中15个设置中13个取得最佳效果，最高较Hybrid RAG提升22.6分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在处理知识密集型任务序列时依赖持久外部源；现有工作在内容访问/组织方式及交互记忆复用方面有所改进，但同一源的重复使用仍仅被视为"重复访问"，而非逐步加深对该源理解的机会，缺乏可复用的源特定能力。

Method: 提出"源学习"研究问题，用持久"源模型"表示对源知识结构、解释与应用的复用性理解；设计 SourceLearn，包含两种互补机制：自导向源学习（识别尚未完全理解之处并自适应重访源）与任务导向源学习（利用下游经验暴露局部表征缺口及源知识组织的反复需求）。学习信号决定重新审视的内容，持久更新均从权威源重构。

Result: 在五个基准、三种LLM后端上，SourceLearn 在15个设置中13个取得最佳性能，较 Hybrid RAG 最高提升22.6分，并显著优于静态源表征与基于经验的记忆基线。

Conclusion: 将源的重复使用从"重复访问"转变为可累积的源特定能力构建，是提升LLM智能体知识密集型任务表现的有效方向；持久源模型结合自导向与任务导向学习可显著增益，且更新始终以权威源为锚保证可靠性。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on persistent external sources to solve sequences of knowledge-intensive tasks. Existing methods improve how source content is accessed and organized, while agent-memory systems preserve reusable knowledge from prior interactions, but repeated use of the same source is still largely treated as repeated access rather than an opportunity to progressively improve understanding of that source. We study source learning: developing reusable source-specific competence over a persistent authoritative source. We represent this competence with a persistent source model that captures reusable understanding of the source, including how its knowledge is structured, interpreted, and applied. To construct and progressively refine such models, we propose SourceLearn, which combines two complementary learning mechanisms. Self-Directed Source Learning identifies what remains incompletely understood and adaptively revisits the source, while Task-Guided Source Learning uses downstream experience to reveal local representational gaps and recurring needs in how source knowledge should be organized. In both cases, learning signals determine what should be reconsidered, while persistent updates are reconstructed from the authoritative source. Across five benchmarks and three LLM backends, SourceLearn achieves the best performance in 13 of 15 settings, with gains of up to 22.6 points over Hybrid RAG and substantial overall improvements over static source representations and experience-based memory baselines.

</details>


### [283] [AutoCompact: Learning When to Compact Context in Long-Horizon Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02163)
*Xuan Zhang,Longtao Zheng,Cunxiao Du,Bo An,Xin Dong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 AutoCompact，训练编码代理将上下文压缩（何时压缩、保留何种工作状态、如何续接）内化为策略的一部分，在 SWE-bench Verified 与 SWE-PolyBench Verified 上相对基线绝对提升 9.2% 和 5.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码代理通过长轨迹完成仓库级软件工程任务，随着任务推进，早期探索信息逐渐失效。因此上下文管理不只是防止溢出，还需要决定压缩时机、保留哪些工作状态以及如何从压缩状态继续执行。现有做法缺乏将这类决策纳入代理策略的训练机制。

Method: 1) 让基础代理在编码任务上运行以收集轨迹；2) 用评判器（judge）审查其压缩决策、摘要及压缩后的动作；3) 将缺陷输出替换为修正版本后再在环境中执行，使每条轨迹从修正后的决策继续；4) 先用这些轨迹做监督微调；5) 再以任务成功奖励进行强化学习，联合优化编码与压缩能力。

Result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 和 SWE-PolyBench Verified 上，AutoCompact 相对基础模型的通过率分别绝对提升 9.2% 与 5.0%。改进在所有评估的推理预算下均成立：256K 上下文窗口下从不溢出，16K 窗口下溢出时触发回退压缩。

Conclusion: 上下文压缩决策可作为编码代理策略的可学习组成部分，通过评判器修正数据构建、监督微调与强化学习的联合训练，可在不同上下文窗口和推理预算下稳定提升仓库级编码任务的成功率。

Abstract: Coding agents solve repository-level software engineering tasks through long trajectories of code inspection, search, editing, and testing. As a task progresses, earlier exploration becomes stale, so managing context is more than avoiding overflow: an agent must decide when to compact, what working state to preserve, and how to continue from it. We introduce AutoCompact, which trains a coding agent to make these decisions as part of its policy. To collect training data, we run the base agent on coding tasks and use a judge to review its compaction decisions, summaries, and actions after compaction. Flawed outputs are replaced with corrected ones before being executed in the environment, so each trajectory continues from the corrected decisions. We use these trajectories for supervised fine-tuning, then jointly optimize coding and compaction through reinforcement learning with task-success rewards. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-PolyBench Verified show that AutoCompact improves pass rates over the base model by an absolute 9.2\% and 5.0\%, respectively. The improvements hold across all evaluated inference budgets, with a 256K context window that never overflows and with a 16K window whose overflow triggers fallback compaction.

</details>


### [284] [Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02193)
*Hui Ren,Zihan Li,Chang Liu,Huidong Liu,Alexander Schwing*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出HC-DLM，将离散token生成与连续隐轨迹耦合于统一去噪过程，在Sudoku、Countdown和LM1B上以相同模型规模超越离散与连续扩散基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散语言模型并行解码时各token从边缘分布独立采样，破坏了同批解码token间的统计依赖；连续扩散语言模型虽通过共享连续状态去噪保留了依赖，但其去噪器仅见到隐状态，在最终解码前与合法token配置无任何约束联系。因此需要一种兼顾二者优势的生成框架。

Method: 提出层次化连续扩散语言模型（HC-DLM）：在单一、有原则的去噪过程中将离散token生成与连续隐轨迹相耦合，训练目标由token似然的变分下界推导得到。与将连续上下文附于自包含离散链的近期方法不同，HC-DLM令隐轨迹成为唯一持久生成状态——每一步从中读出token，并将其反馈作为下一步隐更新的支架（scaffold）。

Result: 在结构化推理（Sudoku）、数学规划（Countdown）和语言建模（LM1B）任务上，模型规模匹配时，HC-DLM在Sudoku与Countdown的谜题准确率及LM1B的生成困惑度上均优于离散扩散与连续扩散基线。

Conclusion: 以连续隐轨迹为唯一持久生成状态、并让token读出与隐更新相互反馈的耦合式扩散框架，能同时缓解离散扩散的独立性采样缺陷与连续扩散的离散-连续失联问题，在推理、规划与语言建模上取得一致改进。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion language models offer a compelling alternative to autoregressive generation for tasks demanding bidirectional reasoning and global constraint satisfaction. Yet they share a structural bottleneck: when decoding in parallel, each token is sampled independently from its marginal, severing the statistical dependencies among the tokens decoded together. Continuous diffusion language models avoid this by denoising a shared continuous state, but their denoiser sees only that state, so nothing ties it to a valid token configuration until it is finally decoded. To address this, we propose Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models (HC-DLM), which couple discrete token generation with a continuous latent trajectory in a single, principled denoising process, whose training objective is derived from a variational bound on the token likelihood. In contrast to recent methods that attach continuous context to a self-contained discrete chain, HC-DLM makes the latent the only persistent generative state: tokens are read out from it at every step and feed back as a scaffold for the next latent update. On structured reasoning (Sudoku), mathematical planning (Countdown) and language modeling (LM1B), HC-DLM improves over discrete and continuous diffusion baselines at matched model size, in puzzle accuracy on Sudoku and Countdown and in generative perplexity on LM1B. Project page: https://hc-dlm.github.io/.

</details>


### [285] [KaliBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Cybersecurity Tool Use on Kali Linux with Runtime-Free Verifiable Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02206)
*Pengfei Li,Naufal Suryanto,Sicheng Zhang,Muzammal Naseer*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出KaliBench基准，含8,504条自然语言到CLI命令的查询-命令对，覆盖1,642个工具，评测显示开放权重模型在无提示下准确率不足42%，并用其可验证奖励训练8B模型达到接近685B MoE模型的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM评测多聚焦知识问答或端到端智能体任务，无法直接衡量模型为真实网络安全工具生成可执行命令的能力。而网络安全操作依赖严格的命令行接口，微小语法错误、错误的标志-值绑定或参数顺序错乱都会导致执行失败，这一空白亟需填补。

Method: 构建KaliBench：基于手册的流水线生成数据，采用确定性规范化与别名感知评测；含8,504条查询-命令对，覆盖Kali Linux上1,642个工具、23个能力维度与5个安全阶段。并通过多阶段验证流水线（LLM校验、沙箱终端执行、人工在环精修）保证语义正确性与可执行性，进而提供免运行时即可验证的奖励信号用于训练。

Result: 在三种评测模式、24种通用与安全专用开放权重模型配置下，无限制设置中无任何开放权重模型超过42%的精确命令准确率；基于KaliBench的可验证奖励进行监督微调与强化学习，显著提升8B模型，性能可媲美685B MoE模型。

Conclusion: KaliBench为自然语言到网络安全CLI命令的翻译提供了细粒度、可复现的评测与训练基准，揭示了当前开放权重模型在无工具提示时的显著能力不足，并证明细粒度确定性信号可用于高效训练小型模型接近大模型水平。

Abstract: LLMs are increasingly applied to cybersecurity workflows, where they are expected to translate analysts' intent into tool invocations. However, existing evaluations focus on knowledge-based assessments or end-to-end agentic tasks, and do not directly measure LLMs' ability to generate executable commands for real-world cybersecurity tools. This gap is critical because cybersecurity operations rely on strict command-line interfaces (CLIs), where minor syntax errors, incorrect flag--value bindings, or argument misordering can invalidate execution. We introduce KaliBench, a fine-grained benchmark and dataset for natural-language--to--CLI translation on Kali Linux, comprising 8,504 query--command pairs spanning 1,642 tools across 23 capability dimensions and 5 security phases. KaliBench is constructed via a manuscript-grounded pipeline with deterministic canonicalization and alias-aware evaluation, enabling precise and reproducible assessment of tool selection and argument construction. To ensure both semantic correctness and practical executability, we develop a multi-stage verification pipeline that combines LLM-based validation, sandboxed terminal execution, and human-in-the-loop refinement. Building on these fine-grained, deterministic signals, KaliBench further enables runtime-free verifiable rewards for training. Across three evaluation modes and 24 configurations of general-purpose and security-focused open-weight models, no open-weight model exceeds 42% exact-command accuracy in the unrestricted setting, highlighting the difficulty of accurate CLI-based cybersecurity tool use without explicit tool hints. We further show that supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards derived from KaliBench significantly improve an 8B model and achieve performance comparable to a 685B MoE model.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [286] [Heavy-Tailed Memory Traces in Long-Horizon Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00010)
*Xinyuan Song,Zekun Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出以“记忆使用的形状”（核心—长尾分布）作为智能体外部记忆的新评价对象，设计基于秩的记忆控制器CTWM，在保持覆盖与准确率的同时显著节省提示词token并降低长尾预测误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前对长时程语言智能体外部记忆的评价仅依赖任务成功率或token成本，忽略了记忆使用的分布形状。在有限上下文与重复检索下，记忆易集中于小核心，稀有状态留在长尾，导致预测误差累积。作者认为需要把这种核心—长尾结构作为缺失的评价与调控对象。

Method: 首先进行保守的长尾审计，检验记忆检索分布的可复现性与策略依赖性；随后提出Core–Tail World Model（CTWM），一种基于秩的记忆控制器，用单一指数τ分配提示预算，同时保留经过摘要的长尾部分，从而在有限预算下兼顾核心状态与稀有状态。

Result: 审计发现记忆集中现象可复现但依赖策略：随机游走智能体产生与对数正态分布相容的检索痕迹，语义LLM策略产生最强的与截断幂律相容的核心—长尾痕迹。在Synthetic Graph World上，CTWM保持完整状态与转移覆盖，相比图记忆基线提示token减少5.9%，下半部长尾预测误差降低13.6%；在ALFWorld上配对比较得到一致的token节省，在LongMemEval上token减少24.48%且总体准确率持平。

Conclusion: 重尾记忆痕迹不仅是有限检索的诊断指标，也可作为实用的控制信号，用于构建token高效的智能体世界模型；CTWM表明按核心—长尾结构分配上下文预算能在不牺牲覆盖与准确率的前提下提升效率。

Abstract: Long-horizon language agents increasingly rely on external memory as a frozen world model, yet current memory systems are usually judged only by task success or token cost. We argue that the missing object is the shape of memory use: under finite context and repeated retrieval, agent memory can concentrate on a small core while leaving rare states in a long tail where prediction errors accumulate. We study this effect through a conservative tail audit and find that concentration is reproducible but policy-dependent. Random-walk agents produce log-normal-compatible retrieval artifacts, whereas semantic LLM policies yield the strongest truncated-power-law-compatible core--tail traces. Motivated by this audit, we propose Core--Tail World Model (CTWM), a rank-based memory controller that allocates prompt budget with a single exponent $τ$ while retaining a summarized tail. On Synthetic Graph World, CTWM preserves full state and transition coverage, reduces prompt tokens by 5.9%, and lowers bottom-half tail prediction error by 13.6% relative to a graph-memory baseline. The same paired comparison gives consistent token savings on ALFWorld and a 24.48% token reduction on LongMemEval with aggregate accuracy parity. These results suggest that heavy-tailed memory traces are not only a diagnostic of finite retrieval, but also a practical control signal for token-efficient agent world models.

</details>


### [287] [When Do Causal World Models Help Modular LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00012)
*Xinyuan Song,Zekun Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出FedCausalCompose，一个面向模块化LLM智能体的因果世界模型框架，论证仅拟合观测轨迹的世界模型在干预时存在不可消除的误差，而利用局部动作提供的干预-响应证据可恢复跨模块接口；实验表明，因果结构仅在接口可统计识别且以智能体可用形式呈现时才带来收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体日益通过订单、支付、库存、物流等模块化服务行动，一个模块中的动作会改变另一模块中有效的状态转移。标准世界模型通常拟合观测轨迹，但观测轨迹并非干预时规划所需的量：轨迹可能显示支付先于发货，却无法区分支付是否授权发货、库存是否中介该效应，或是否存在隐藏触发因素同时导致二者。因此需要研究观测世界模型在跨模块干预规划中的结构性缺陷。

Method: 提出FedCausalCompose因果世界模型框架，利用模块内局部动作作为干预-响应证据，用于恢复跨模块接口。理论上分析三条命题：(1) 在未阻断的后门路径下，观测世界模型产生不可消除的干预误差；(2) 接口恢复质量随干预-响应覆盖度提升；(3) 在覆盖度与局部机制误差受控时，oracle因果组合可优于非因果下界。随后在诊断性智能体环境中检验该预测，对比结构化工具环境与对话/叙事环境。

Result: 因果接口在结构化工具环境中收益最大——此类环境的API签名显式暴露前置条件与下游效应；相反，对话与叙事环境往往忽略原始边列表，除非加入简短的注意力锚点使因果信息与决策相关。

Conclusion: 因果世界模型在LLM智能体中发挥作用存在明确条件：当跨模块接口既具备统计可识别性，又以智能体在行动时可用的形式呈现时，因果结构才能带来收益。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly act through modular systems, such as order, payment, inventory, and shipment services, where actions in one module change which transitions are valid in another. Standard world models usually fit observational traces, but this is not the quantity needed for intervention-time planning: a trace may show that payment precedes shipment without identifying whether payment authorizes shipment, inventory mediates the effect, or a hidden trigger explains both. We study this gap through FedCausalCompose, a causal world-model framework for modular LLM agents in which local actions provide intervention-response evidence for cross-module interfaces. We first show that observational world models incur an irreducible interventional error under unblocked back-door paths, that interface recovery improves with intervention-response coverage, and that an oracle causal composition can beat the non-causal lower bound when coverage and local mechanism errors are controlled. We then test the resulting prediction in diagnostic agent settings. Causal interfaces help most in structured tool environments, where API signatures expose preconditions and downstream effects. In contrast, dialogue and narrative environments often ignore raw edge lists unless a short attention anchor makes the causal information decision-relevant. These results identify a concrete condition for causal world models in LLM agents: causal structure helps when cross-module interfaces are both statistically identifiable and presented in a form the agent can use at action time.

</details>


### [288] [From Proposal to Verified Effect: Praxa, an Evidence-Bound Harness for Governed AI Agent Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00015)
*Stefan G. Creadore*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Praxa——一种将"提议、授权、派发、已核实外部效果、上线提升"区分开来的智能体执行框架，通过确定性准入、代理执行、外部回读、对账与评审式提升显式表示这些状态，并报告四条证据通道，其可支持的贡献是一个可测试的"授权到效果"证据绑定架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型智能体能够提出并执行动作，但"提出动作""获得授权""实际派发""产生经核实的外部效果""被推广至线上服务"是彼此不同的主张，现有工作常将其混为一谈，缺少对这些状态转换的显式、可测试的表示。

Method: 提出 Praxa 智能体框架，显式刻画上述状态，由确定性准入、代理执行、外部回读、对账和评审式提升五个环节组成；并以四条证据通道进行评估： (1) 固定版本下的仓库内自审（单元测试、Workerd 测试、源码插桩与覆盖率门限）；(2) 基于外部服务商的 Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1 试点（12 个精选任务，基线组与可靠性层组各 36 次严格试验）；(3) 调试后的双序协调代理开发对比（基线与源码自撰候选各 180 次试验）；(4) 已部署的源码/配置证据检查。

Result: 通道一：1027/1027 单元测试、89/89 Workerd 测试通过，363 个预期源文件全部插桩并满足四项覆盖率门限，但原始逐测记录与独立复现不可得。通道二：基线与可靠性层各通过 17/36，可靠性层多耗 37.49% 输入与 50.73% 输出 token，不支持其优越性。通道三：两者均 180/180 完成且测得准确率相同、具备完全封闭式崩溃恢复与零违规，候选方案少用 37.11% token、降低 33.84% 估算端点成本、减少 11.63% 步骤，但不足以证明质量、延迟或生产行为改善。通道四：存在有界反思、召回核算、记忆编译与工具健康路径的部署证据，但无生产结果提升。

Conclusion: Praxa 的可支持贡献是使"授权到效果"的状态转换显式且可测试的证据绑定架构；当前证据不足以确立对抗安全性、生产安全、通用专用模型优越性、自主递归优化或用户收益。

Abstract: Large-language-model agents can propose and execute actions, but proposal, authority, dispatch, verified external effect, and serving promotion are different claims. We present Praxa, an agent harness that represents these states explicitly through deterministic admission, brokered execution, external read-back, reconciliation, and reviewed promotion. We report four evidence lanes. First, an author-run repository-local audit at a pinned revision passed 1,027/1,027 unit tests and 89/89 Workerd tests, instrumented all 363 expected source files, and met four coverage floors; raw per-test transcripts and independent reproduction are unavailable. Second, in a provider-backed Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1 pilot across 12 curated tasks, baseline and reliability-layer arms each passed 17/36 strict trials. The reliability layer used 37.49% more input and 50.73% more output tokens, so the pilot does not support superiority. Third, in a post-debug, two-order coordination-proxy development comparison, baseline and a source-authored candidate each completed 180/180 trials with equal measured accuracy, full hermetic crash recovery, and zero protected violations. The candidate used 37.11% fewer tokens, 33.84% lower estimated endpoint cost, and 11.63% fewer steps; this does not establish improved quality, latency, or production behavior. Fourth, deployed source/configuration evidence shows bounded reflection, recall accounting, memory compilation, and tool-health paths, but no production outcome lift. Praxa's supported contribution is an evidence-bound architecture that makes authority-to-effect transitions explicit and testable. Current evidence does not establish adversarial security, production safety, general specialist superiority, autonomous recursive optimization, or user benefit.

</details>


### [289] [What Do Rationales Communicate? A Message-Intervention Study in Role-Specialized QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00018)
*Jiameng Zhang,Hongqiu Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"消息干预"诊断方法，在固定证据与候选答案的前提下仅改变reasoner传给verifier的rationale，发现忠实的rationale几乎不提升答案准确率，而损坏的rationale却强烈改变支持性判断，说明rationale共享应被视为一种验证消息机制而非单纯提升准确率的途径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 角色分工式QA流水线越来越多地在reasoner与verifier之间传递rationale，但尚不清楚这一消息传递究竟带来什么：是更好的答案、更强的支持性评估，还是一个新的失败面。作者希望通过隔离rationale这一变量，厘清reasoner-to-verifier通道的真实作用。

Method: 作者提出一种消息干预诊断方法：固定证据与候选答案，仅改变跨reasoner-to-verifier边界传递的rationale。在400个MuSiQue、HotpotQA与2WikiMultiHopQA样本上，以DeepSeek作为生成器与验证器开展实验，对比无rationale、忠实rationale、无害改写（paraphrase）与损坏rationale（corruption）条件下的支持性判断与最终答案，并设置盲验证与显式rationale检查两种提示，配合人工审计与跨模型、任务边界检验。

Result: 忠实rationale相比无rationale几乎不提升答案准确率，而损坏rationale强烈改变支持性判断。盲验证提示下，无害改写仅使支持性变动0–2.5%，而损坏rationale使其变动10–22%；显式rationale检查提示将同一模式放大至34–55%。最终答案变动较小（2–30%），且仅2.9–35.3%的损坏支持翻转伴随答案改变。人工审计显示42个有效损坏中有16个为"损坏过度信任"案例，盲测人类对模型接受的10个被审计损坏rationale中拒绝或标记为不明确的达9个。跨模型与任务边界检验进一步表明该通道可处于激活、放大、惰性或被并入任务标签等不同状态。

Conclusion: rationale共享应作为一种验证消息机制来评估，而不仅仅被视为通往更高答案准确率的途径。该通道制造了新的失败面：模型会过度信任损坏的rationale，而人类却能识别其中多数问题。

Abstract: Role-specialized QA pipelines increasingly pass rationales from a reasoner to a verifier, but it is unclear what this message actually buys: better answers, stronger support assessment, or a new failure surface. We introduce a message-intervention diagnostic that fixes the evidence and candidate answer while varying only the rationale passed across the reasoner-to-verifier boundary. On 400 MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and 2WikiMultiHopQA examples with DeepSeek as generator and verifier, faithful rationales add almost no answer accuracy over no rationale, while corrupted rationales strongly alter support judgments. Under a blind verifier prompt, harmless paraphrases shift support by only 0--2.5%, whereas corrupted rationales shift support by 10--22%; an explicit rationale-checking prompt amplifies the same pattern to 34--55%. Final answers move less (2--30%), and only 2.9--35.3% of corrupted support flips co-occur with answer changes. Human audits show why this matters: 16/42 valid corruptions are corruption-overtrust cases, and blind humans reject or mark unclear 9/10 audited corrupted rationales that the model accepts. Cross-model and task-boundary checks show when the channel is active, amplified, inert, or folded into the task label. Rationale sharing should be evaluated as a verification-message mechanism, not merely as a route to higher answer accuracy.

</details>


### [290] [Measuring the Microtask Eligibility Gap: When Is an Off-the-Shelf SLM Enough for an Agent Harness?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00025)
*Jundong Hu,Shekar Ramachandran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文构建了4个agent微任务的基准（含预设阈值τ与CI资格规则），扫描Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B（FP16）发现16/16配置无一合格；通过logprob决策阈值诊断将失败分为能力缺陷与解码阈值可修正两类（4种regime），4-bit量化（RTN/GPTQ/AWQ）不改变资格结论，失败主要随模型规模而非精度变化；结论建议SLM仅作为未能达标基线的补充。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent框架越来越多地希望在LLM规划器周边的微任务（如自动批准shell命令、写记忆、选工具、历史轮次排序）上使用小型语言模型（SLM）。作者要回答：现成SLM能否达到实践者设定的阈值；若不能，原因是什么；量化是否会改变结论。

Method: 构建含4个微任务的基准，使用固定提示与自动指标，每个任务预设阈值τ（锚定于廉价非LLM基线），并采用CI感知的资格规则（置信界需超过τ才合格）。在Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B上以最优设置（FP16、贪心解码、单一冻结提示、不调优）进行扫描；用logprob决策阈值诊断（T1/T3/T4直接诊断，T2用上下文长度/级联探针）区分失败类型；对4-bit量化（RTN/GPTQ/AWQ）在T1/T3上做硬标签可重构认证，在T2/T4上做诊断/窗口稳健性分析；并在Llama-3.x上复现，同时进行τ扫描与提示改写稳健性检验。

Result: 存在“资格缺口”：16个配置（4任务×4模型）全部不合格（通过检查原始输出与解析器行为验证）。诊断将失败分为能力缺陷与可通过调整解码阈值解决的失败（共4种regime）。4-bit量化造成的损害取决于模型规模，且未能使任何配置进入合格状态，说明缺口更多随模型规模而非精度变化。结论在Llama-3.x上复现（12/12不合格），并对锚点选择（τ扫描）与提示措辞（原始加3个中性改写共0/112合格）稳健。作为补充基线策略，4B重排序器在BM25候选集上优于BM25（+0.047 [0.020, 0.073]），但自身仍未通过资格认证。

Conclusion: 实践建议是将SLM置于满足CI-backed阈值的基线之后，仅在基线未达阈值处使用SLM。例如用4B重排序器处理BM25短名单可优于BM25，但该SLM本身并不满足合格标准。整体上，现成SLM在agent微任务上普遍不达实践者阈值，且该缺口主要由模型规模驱动而非量化精度。

Abstract: Agent harnesses increasingly want to run small language models (SLMs) on the microtasks around a frontier large language model (LLM) planner: auto-approving shell commands, writing memory, selecting tools, ranking past turns. We ask whether off-the-shelf SLMs meet practitioner-defined thresholds and, when they fail, why, and whether quantization changes the answer. We build a benchmark of 4 such microtasks with fixed prompts and automatic metrics, each with a pre-specified threshold $τ$ anchored to a cheap non-LLM baseline and a CI-aware eligibility rule (a configuration passes only if its confidence bound clears $τ$). Sweeping Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B at their best (FP16, greedy, one frozen prompt, no tuning), we find an eligibility gap: 0 of 16 (4 tasks $\times$ 4 models) configurations pass (verified by checking the raw outputs and parser behavior). A logprob decision-threshold diagnostic (T1/T3/T4; T2 via a context-length/cascade probe) separates the failures into capability deficits and failures that can be addressed by changing the decoding threshold (4 regimes). Quantization to 4-bit (RTN/GPTQ/AWQ) does damage that depends on model size and moves no configuration into eligibility (certified on the reconstructable hard-label tasks T1/T3, diagnostic/windowed robustness on T2/T4), so the gap tracks model size more than precision; it replicates on Llama-3.x (12/12 ineligible) and is robust to the anchor choice (a $τ$-sweep) and to prompt wording (0/112 eligible across the original plus 3 neutral paraphrases per cell). The practical implication: place SLMs behind a baseline that meets the CI-backed threshold, and use the SLM only where the baseline fails to meet the threshold; e.g. a 4B re-ranker over a BM25 shortlist beats BM25 ($+0.047$ [0.020, 0.073], without itself certifying eligibility).

</details>


### [291] [Characterizing a Configuration Where Inference-Time PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting Is Inert: Evidence from Three Reasoning LMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00047)
*Khawaja Murad ul Hassan,Mehran Ebrahimi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将"用PRM剪枝片段的优质前缀移植到并行解码的兄弟链作为上下文示例"(PPFG)这一机制单独隔离出来检验,发现其在所测工作点上与独立并行CoT基线在统计上无差异,并将其升格为正向等价结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并行思维链的多样性坍塌催生了多种推理时干预,其中一种自然设计是:当过程奖励模型(PRM)剪掉某条链时,抽取其高PRM前缀并原样移植为上下文示例,注入仍在解码的兄弟链。此前片段移植类工作仅在其他补偿性条件配合下才报告增益,本文旨在剥离该机制单独检验,明确其自身的因果贡献。

Method: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct + Math-Shepherd、完整MATH500(n=500,3个随机种子)上,对比PPFG的停滯目标与随机目标两种变体与独立并行CoT基线;对322次停滞规则注入事件做四桶分类以定位失效原因;测试复合门控精化与随机控制;在3个基座LM、6个基准、第二个PRM及兼容性门控扫描上复现;采用双单侧检验(TOST)将"无差异"提升为正向等价;并做逐事件抽查与幸存兄弟反事实分析,另用事后oracle给出上界。

Result: PPFG两种变体在所有测量维度上与独立并行CoT基线统计不可区分。322次注入事件中仅14%命中真正挣扎的链,其余落在已成功、接近完成或PRM平坦平台等"救援无法改变"的状态;没有复合门控能同时实现精准触发与足够密度,随机控制在2.4倍触发率下也呈同等平价,说明惰性并非启发式特有。结论在3个基座LM、6个基准、第二个PRM及门控扫描中复现,TOST在全部12个Qwen/LLaMA单元上把平价升格为正向等价。逐事件抽查显示注入链的剪枝率为匹配步率的2.75倍,但幸存兄弟反事实未见群体层面补偿;事后oracle将选择PPFG而非独立基线的单题增益上界限定为+0.13个百分点。

Conclusion: PPFG作为跨轨迹步级迁移的最省成本操作化形式,在所测工作点上对结果无实质影响,其失效源于触发目标与救援可行状态严重错配而非特定启发式缺陷。本文贡献了一套推理时机制零假设的等价性检验模板,并强调所有论断均限于其检验过的工作点。

Abstract: Diversity collapse in parallel chain-of-thought has motivated inference-time interventions built on a natural design: when a process reward model (PRM) prunes a chain, its high-PRM prefix is extracted and grafted verbatim as an in-context demonstration into a still-decoding sibling. We isolate this mechanism, PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting (PPFG), as the most cost-minimal operationalization of cross-trajectory step-level transfer, and test it at the operating point where prior fragment-grafting work reports gains only under additional compensating ingredients. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with Math-Shepherd on full MATH500 (n=500, three seeds), PPFG in both stagnation- and random-targeting variants is statistically indistinguishable from an independent parallel-CoT baseline on every measured axis. We characterize why: a four-bucket classification of 322 stagnation-rule injection events shows only 14% targeted a genuinely struggling chain; the rest landed on chains that had already succeeded, were near completion, or sat on a flat PRM plateau, states a rescue graft cannot change. No compound-gate refinement jointly achieves well-targeted firing and adequate density, and a random control matches the same parity at 2.4x the firing rate, so the inertness is not heuristic-specific. The finding replicates across three base LMs, six benchmarks, a second PRM, and a compatibility-gate sweep; two-one-sided-tests analysis promotes the parity to positive equivalence on all twelve Qwen/LLaMA cells. A per-event spot-check finds injected chains prune at 2.75x the matched-step rate, but a surviving-sibling counterfactual finds no population-level compensation. A hindsight oracle bounds any per-problem gain from choosing PPFG over independent at +0.13 pp. We contribute an equivalence-testing template for establishing inference-time mechanism nulls, with every claim scoped to its tested operating point.

</details>


### [292] [Gradient-Aligned Pair Selection for Personalized Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00061)
*Ruoming Jin,Xinyu Li,Hao Zhou,Jianfeng Zhu,Ruixin Guo,Feodor Dragan,Lei Xu,Haixun Wang,Yang Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将个性化偏好学习形式化为几何对齐优化问题，揭示DPO更新方向与用户效用梯度的对齐关系，提出GAP-DPO算法实现效用感知、几何对齐的偏好对选择，在个性化文本生成任务上超越标准DPO变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化LLM需使生成行为对齐用户特定偏好而非整体质量。DPO虽为偏好学习提供稳定框架，但在个性化场景中其效果关键取决于偏好对的选择方式。现有方法多依赖启发式准则（如基于似然的极值），将优化与显式用户效用解耦，导致个性化效果退化。

Method: 作者通过分析期望用户效用梯度与DPO更新方向之间的一阶交互，将个性化偏好学习形式化为几何对齐的优化问题。分析表明，在离策略采样下，当偏好边际与效用梯度方向对齐时，DPO更新从纯误差纠正信号转变为类强化学习更新。基于此提出GAP-DPO（Geometry-Aligned Preference DPO），一种迭代算法：执行效用感知、几何对齐的偏好对选择，并通过逐轮重新生成控制分布偏移。

Result: 在个性化文本生成基准上，GAP-DPO在风格保真度、偏好对齐和生成质量方面均持续优于标准DPO变体。

Conclusion: 研究确立梯度对齐为个性化偏好优化的统一原则，证明偏好对选择是优化几何的内在组成部分，而非启发式预处理步骤。

Abstract: Personalizing large language models (LLMs) requires aligning generation behavior with user-specific preferences rather than aggregate quality. While Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) provides a stable framework for preference learning, its effectiveness in personalized settings critically depends on how preference pairs are selected. Existing approaches typically rely on heuristic criteria, such as likelihood-based extremes, which decouple optimization from explicit user utility and can lead to degraded personalization. We formalize personalized preference learning as a geometry-aligned optimization problem by analyzing the first-order interaction between gradients of expected user utility and DPO update directions. Our analysis reveals that, under off-policy sampling, the DPO update transitions from a purely error-corrective signal to a reinforcement-like update when preference margins are directionally aligned with utility gradients. This perspective exposes pair selection as a geometric decision that governs whether preference optimization advances or hinders personalization. Motivated by this insight, we propose GAP-DPO (Geometry-Aligned Preference DPO), an iterative algorithm that performs utility-aware, geometry-aligned pair selection while controlling distribution shift via epoch-wise regeneration. Experiments on personalized text generation benchmarks show that GAP-DPO consistently improves stylistic fidelity, preference alignment, and generation quality compared to standard DPO variants. Together, our results establish gradient alignment as a unifying principle for personalized preference optimization and demonstrate that pair selection is an intrinsic component of the optimization geometry rather than a heuristic preprocessing step.

</details>


### [293] [K-Dense BYOK: An Open-Source AI Research Assistant That Runs Locally and Keeps a Hash-Chained Lab Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00074)
*Aubrey M. Brueckner,Darshil Patel,Yuhuan He,Timothy Kassis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: K-Dense BYOK 是一款免费开源、本地运行的 AI 科研助手，采用自带模型密钥（BYOK）模式，通过科学脚手架、Living Lab Notebook 与独立观测日志三大机制提升科研可核查性，并在二十个跨学科研究提示上于科学质量与研究执行两项指标上优于两个托管平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用聊天助手与通用编码智能体缺乏科研专用支撑：缺少科学流程与工作流模板、数据源目录、审稿与写作角色；且模型普遍存在夸大结论（overclaiming）问题。作者前期在九个前沿模型基准测试中发现该失败模式最为常见，因此希望通过机制设计使主张可被核查，而非简单禁止模型下结论。同时，研究者需要数据、代码、结果与记录长期留存于自己可管理的机器上，不依赖特定应用即可多年后读取。

Method: 采用本地运行、BYOK 架构，研究者自行提供所选模型（云端或本地部署），应用提供运行环境、科学脚手架与完整记录；每个项目为普通文件夹，数据、代码、结果和记录均保存在研究者自管机器上。三大差异化机制：（1）内置书面科学流程库、引导式工作流模板、研究数据来源目录，以及可转交任务的审稿人与写作者角色；（2）Living Lab Notebook，条目相互链接构成论证，只增不删；（3）通过观察智能体实际行为而非采信其自述来记录过程，日志智能体无任何可写入的工具。评测采用事先固定的评分量规，在二十个跨学科研究提示上与两个托管平台对比，考察科学质量与研究执行。

Result: K-Dense BYOK 在科学质量与研究执行两方面均领先两个托管平台。其交付物是唯一记录了所运行软件的产物，也是唯一通常会附带可复现结果命令的产物。其中一个托管平台使用了相同的前沿模型，却未提供这两项内容。需注意，这些环境记录是智能体写入的文件，而非观测日志的一部分，观测日志目前尚未捕获软件环境本身。

Conclusion: 通过“使主张可核查而非阻止主张”的设计，K-Dense BYOK 在跨学科研究任务中展现出优于托管平台的科学质量与执行表现，并提升了可复现性与过程可追溯性。当前局限在于软件环境记录仍依赖智能体自写文件，观测日志尚未覆盖环境本身，是后续改进方向。代码以 MIT 许可发布于 https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/k-dense-byok。

Abstract: K-Dense BYOK (bring your own keys) is a free, open-source AI research assistant for scientists in any field that runs on the researcher's own computer. The researcher supplies access to a model of their choice, hosted or running locally, and the application supplies everything else: a place for the work to run, a layer of scientific scaffolding, and a complete record. Each project is an ordinary folder, so the data, the code, the results, and the record stay on a machine the researcher administers and can be read years later without the application. Three things separate it from a chat assistant or a general-purpose coding agent. It ships a library of written scientific procedures, guided workflow templates, catalogs of where research data can be found, and reviewer and writer roles the agent can hand work to. It keeps a Living Lab Notebook whose entries link into an argument and are added to but never erased. And it records what happened by watching what the agent does rather than by taking the agent's word for it, in a log the agent has no tool that can write to. That choice targets the most common failure, model overclaiming, in our earlier benchmark of nine frontier models, by making claims checkable rather than preventing them. On twenty interdisciplinary research prompts, scored under a rubric fixed in advance, K-Dense BYOK led two managed platforms on both scientific quality and research execution. Its deliverables were the only ones that recorded the software they ran in, and the only ones that usually arrived with a command that regenerates the results. One of the managed platforms ran the same frontier model and supplied neither. Those environment records were files the agent wrote, not part of the observed log, which does not yet capture the software environment itself. The code is available under the MIT license at https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/k-dense-byok.

</details>


### [294] [Scientific Agents: Evaluating Profession-Specific System Prompts on Scientific Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00084)
*Timothy Kassis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 专业领域专属系统提示会增加 token 消耗与成本，却未带来稳定准确率提升：503 个职业 profile 语料在九项科学基准与一项工具型任务上均未优于极简基线，唯一优势是长提示对 API 中断的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验"为模型加载详细专业领域系统提示（profession-specific profiles）能提升科学任务表现"这一常见假设，评估其准确率收益与 token/成本代价是否匹配。

Method: 评估开源语料 Scientific Agents（503 个职业专属 AGENTS.md profile），模型为 Gemini 3.8 Flash，经 OpenRouter 在 Pi agent harness 中运行。对 100 个匹配 profile 设置四类对照：极简基线（"You are a helpful assistant"）、profile 开头角色句、通用科学严谨性指南、无关领域的 profile。在九个文本科学基准上采样 4,531 题，API 错误重试后 4,488 题完成全部五种条件，采用自动化规则化评分。另在 60 道需工具调用的 BioMysteryBench 生物信息学题上对基线与 profile 各运行三次。

Result: 平均 profile-基线准确率差为 -0.6 个百分点（固定任务上 95% bootstrap 区间 [-1.5, +0.2]），无任何基准显示显著提升。匹配 profile 输出 token 为基线的 1.5–2.3 倍，单次成功调用成本为 2.2–4.5 倍。BioMysteryBench 上平均解题率 profile 46.7% vs 基线 56.7%，差 -10.0 个百分点（95% 区间 [-16.7, -3.3]），主因是 profile 条件下更频繁触发 token 与时间上限停止。唯一意外优势出现在 SuperGPQA：频繁的供应商 API 中断使短基线仅 54.0% 题目保有首轮正确答案，而 profile 为 71.6%；但通用与错配提示的可靠性相当，说明该收益源于提示长度/格式而非领域专长。

Conclusion: 在受测模型与任务上，默认加载完整职业 profile 不提升准确率且成本显著更高；profile 的唯一可取处是对 API 中断等运行层扰动的鲁棒性，且与领域专业度无关。选择性检索 profile 片段或开放式科学任务能否改变该结论，尚待进一步验证。

Abstract: Detailed profession-specific system prompts raise token use and estimated cost per response without a consistent accuracy gain. We evaluate Scientific Agents, an open-source corpus of 503 profession-specific AGENTS.md profiles, with Gemini 3.8 Flash via OpenRouter in the Pi agent harness. We compare matched profiles with four controls: a minimal baseline ("You are a helpful assistant"), the profile's opening role sentence, a generic scientific rigor guide, and a profile from an unrelated domain. Across nine text-based science benchmarks (4,531 sampled questions, 100 matched profiles), 4,488 items completed all five conditions after API-error retries, scored with automated, rule-based grading. The average profile-baseline accuracy difference is -0.6 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval [-1.5, +0.2] across fixed tasks), and no benchmark shows a statistically clear improvement. Matched profiles produced 1.5-2.3 times as many output tokens and cost 2.2-4.5 times more per successful call. On 60 tool-using BioMysteryBench bioinformatics problems (three runs each for baseline and profile), mean solve rates were 46.7% with the profile and 56.7% at baseline, a difference of -10.0 percentage points (95% interval [-16.7, -3.3]) driven by more frequent token- and time-limit stops under the profile. Longer prompts had one unexpected operational advantage: on SuperGPQA, frequent provider API drops left the short baseline with a correct first-pass answer on only 54.0% of items, against 71.6% with the profile. Generic and mismatched prompts were about as reliable, so this gain comes from prompt length or formatting rather than domain expertise. For the tested model and tasks, loading full profession profiles by default does not improve accuracy and costs considerably more; whether selective retrieval of profile sections or open-ended scientific tasks would change this remains to be tested.

</details>


### [295] [Comedic Fool's Gold: Reward Exploits and Countermeasures in Conversational Humor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00197)
*Sam Larson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究对话幽默训练中自动化奖励的漏洞与对策：基于嵌入的"意外性"奖励易被词序打乱文本欺骗，基于观众笑声预测的奖励易受笑声线索攻击；作者通过归一化等对策阻断已知攻击，但幽默专项提升仍低于预定目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为语言模型设计对话幽默训练奖励时，自动化奖励容易被"奖励漏洞"（reward exploits）利用，即模型学到的是捷径而非真正的幽默能力。作者希望系统性地识别这些漏洞并检验对策，从而揭示自动奖励设计的普遍性挑战。

Method: 采用两类奖励思路：(1) 捕捉"可理解的意外性"的嵌入式惊讶奖励，并加装流畅性过滤器；(2) 预测观众娱乐度的观众模型奖励，并对说话者间的笑声线索做跨说话者归一化。通过受控测试检验漏洞，并开展三次强化学习训练，逐次修订奖励进行对比评估。

Result: 嵌入式惊讶奖励将词序打乱的回复与巧妙回复同等接受；流畅性过滤器能检测打乱文本，但组合奖励会误拒部分巧妙回复且未通过后续验证。观众模型的预测笑声易受任一方消息中的笑声线索影响；跨说话者归一化可阻断已覆盖攻击，但未匹配的表达仍可被利用。最终一次RL运行使综合评分提升0.0903、零分会话减少40%，但幽默专项提升低于预设目标。

Conclusion: 自动化奖励设计的核心难点在于：对策必须同时阻断可利用的捷径，又保留奖励原本想要鼓励的行为。单纯的过滤器或归一化可堵住已知漏洞，却可能牺牲目标行为或留下未覆盖的攻击面。

Abstract: We investigate automated rewards for training language models in conversational humor, focusing on reward exploits and countermeasures. Two approaches aim to capture understandable surprise and predicted audience amusement. Controlled tests show that an embedding-based surprise reward accepts word-shuffled replies as readily as witty ones. A fluency filter detects the shuffles, but the combined reward also rejects some witty replies and fails further validation. An audience model's predicted laughter is instead vulnerable to laughter cues in either speaker's messages. Normalizing these cues across speakers blocks the covered attacks, although unmatched expressions remain exploitable. Three reinforcement-learning runs evaluate training with successive reward revisions. The final run improves the combined evaluation score by 0.0903 and reduces zero-score sessions by 40%, but its humor-specific improvement remains below our preregistered target. These findings illustrate a broader challenge for automated reward design: countermeasures must block exploitable shortcuts while preserving the behavior the reward was intended to encourage.

</details>


### [296] [EviGraph: Proof-Carrying Selective Recommendation over Temporal Public-Service Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00212)
*Yixi Zhou,Sikun Wang,Lei Fan,Fan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 EviGraph，区分决策所需的“关键要求”与可保留未决的信息，用语言智能体在时序知识图谱中关联证据，并以确定性检查器判定推荐是否有支撑；在香港公共服务基准上减少不必要弃答，但过度验证会撤回受支持推荐而不提升决策质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公共服务推荐需要与服务、范围和日期匹配的证据，但将每个缺失细节都视为决定性依据会导致系统过度弃答，从而扣留有用推荐。因此需要明确区分哪些信息是决策必须确立的、哪些可以暂时不解决。

Method: 提出 EviGraph：由语言智能体将关键决策要求链接到时序知识图谱中的证据，并通过确定性检查器判定推荐是否被证据支持，从而在“关键要求”与“可未决信息”之间做出区分。

Result: 在带可执行政策引用的双语香港公共服务基准上评估，该区分能减少不必要的弃答；但额外验证会撤回本已受支持的推荐，且未提升决策质量。

Conclusion: 可靠的循证导航依赖于明确“一个决策必须确立哪些条件”，而非单纯增加验证步骤。

Abstract: Public-service recommendations require evidence that matches the requested service, scope, and date. Yet treating every missing detail as decisive can withhold useful recommendations. We introduce EviGraph, which distinguishes critical decision requirements from information that can remain unresolved. A language agent links these requirements to evidence in a temporal knowledge graph, while a deterministic checker establishes whether a recommendation is supported. Evaluation on a bilingual Hong Kong public-service benchmark with executable policy references shows that this distinction reduces unnecessary abstention. Additional verification, however, can withdraw supported recommendations without improving decision quality. These findings suggest that reliable evidence-based navigation depends on specifying what must be established for a decision, rather than simply adding more verification.

</details>


### [297] [Build2SPARQL: A Large-Scale Text-to-SPARQL Benchmark Dataset for Building Knowledge Graph Querying](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00224)
*Wooyoung Jung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Build2SPARQL，一个面向建筑知识图谱的大规模text-to-SPARQL基准，通过图谱遍历代码生成并验证SPARQL查询、仅由大模型生成自然语言问题，在201个建筑KG上产出6,136条可执行SPARQL查询与30,680个问题，检索增强评估使精确匹配准确率从0.2-20%提升至56-65%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑自动化系统越来越多地以Brick、ASHRAE 223P等本体构建为语义知识图谱，为AI应用提供机器可读基础，其中text-to-SPARQL可将自然语言问题转为SPARQL查询以支持楼宇运维人员通过语言代理查询图谱，但该方向进展受限于大规模自然语言/SPARQL基准的稀缺。

Method: 采用KG-grounding流水线：SPARQL查询完全由图遍历代码生成并验证，大模型仅生成自然语言问题，从而保证查询正确性独立于模型行为；挖掘六类查询模式族（线性链、分支、UNION、聚合、OPTIONAL、属性过滤），并将每个查询表述为五种词汇register；应用于201个建筑KG（180个Brick、21个ASHRAE 223P）。

Result: 生成6,136条可执行SPARQL查询与30,680个问题；对300个问题的双标注者人工验证显示语义保真度98.8%、自然度98.8%、可操作合理性84.0%；跨三个开放权重语言模型的检索增强评估将精确匹配准确率从零样本的0.2-20%提升至三样本检索的56-65%。

Conclusion: Build2SPARQL通过代码生成查询、模型仅生成问题的解耦设计，提供了大规模且查询正确性可控的建筑KG text-to-SPARQL基准，验证了其数据质量与检索增强对提升语言模型查询准确率的有效性。

Abstract: Building automation systems are increasingly represented as semantic knowledge graphs (KGs) using ontologies such as Brick and ASHRAE 223P, creating a machine-readable substrate for artificial-intelligence applications. One promising application is translating natural-language questions into SPARQL (text-to-SPARQL), which would let building operators query these graphs through language agents, but progress is limited by the scarcity of large natural-language/SPARQL benchmarks. This paper presents Build2SPARQL, a large-scale benchmark for building KGs generated by a KG-grounded pipeline: SPARQL queries are produced and validated entirely by graph-traversal code, while large language models generate only the natural-language questions, keeping query correctness independent of model behavior. The pipeline mines six query-pattern families -- linear chains, branching, UNION, aggregation, OPTIONAL, and attribute-filtered -- and phrases each query across five vocabulary registers. Applied to 201 building KGs (180 Brick, 21 ASHRAE 223P), it yields 6,136 executable SPARQL queries and 30,680 questions. A two-rater human validation of 300 questions found 98.8% semantic fidelity, 98.8% naturalness, and 84.0% operational plausibility. A retrieval-augmented evaluation across three open-weight language models raised exact-match accuracy from 0.2-20% (zero-shot) to 56-65% (three-shot retrieved).

</details>


### [298] [Robust Is Salient: An Informed Adversary Moves the Optimal Signal onto the Salience Pole](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00233)
*Cris Huynh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在受限信号通道中引入知晓答案的对手后，最优信号从贝叶斯后验最大化转向显著性最大化；稳健最优与先验"显著性极点"高度重合，导致对手感知能力在经验上不可评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究在信号可能被有信息优势的对手利用的受限通信场景下，发送者应如何选择信号以保护真值。先前工作提出了基于显著性的信号选择，但缺乏对手鲁棒性的理论刻画，作者希望明确对手鲁棒最优解的性质及其与既有显著性解的差异。

Method: 将对手引入强制选择任务（抽象自《Deception: Murder in Hong Kong》）。对手知晓目标、观察信号，并用说服预算 β 为最强错误答案辩护。通过求解该博弈的均衡，分析随 β 增大最优信号的变化，并在 108 个确认性条目与 200,000 条目池上与先验显著性极点比较。

Result: 在 108 个确认性条目上，对手鲁棒最优与先验显著性极点完全一致；在 200,000 条目池中仅 2,748 条不同，且差异均出现在显著性—贝叶斯坐标未定义处。β 增大时最优信号从后验最大化转向边际最大化，β=0 时退化为温度 τ=1 的原始 oracle 模型。18.2% 的池存在有限预算下最优解偏移，且每条目临界预算可精确计算。两种对手框架使七个语言模型在 108 条中的 30 至 77 条上改变所选选项，超过精确无效应率，但由于稳健目标与显著性目标相同，无法判定其转向对手感知最优还是显著性。

Conclusion: 对手鲁棒最优与启发式显著性目标在结构上重合，这一巧合构成经验评估的结构性局限而非零结果。在评估模型的对手感知能力之前，应先检验稳健目标是否与评估条目上的启发式目标一致，该诊断成本低廉。

Abstract: When an informed adversary shares the audience of a constrained signalling channel, the signal that best protects the truth is the signal that best describes it. On 108 confirmatory items, the adversary-robust optimum aligns exactly with the salience pole from prior work. Across a 200,000-item pool, the two differ on only 2,748 items --- lying exactly where the prior salience-to-Bayes coordinate is undefined. Where defined, robustness is achieved by moving from Bayesian discrimination entirely to salience. We show this by introducing an adversary to a forced-choice task (abstracted from Deception: Murder in Hong Kong). The adversary knows the target, observes the signal, and argues for the strongest wrong answer using a persuasion budget, $β$. As $β$ grows, the optimal signal shifts from the posterior-maximizing option to the margin-maximizing one; at $β= 0$, the game reproduces the original oracle model with a listener temperature of $τ= 1$. This effect is real: 18.2 percent of the pool has an optimum that shifts under a finite budget, and each item's critical budget is exact. This coincidence structurally limits empirical evaluation. Two adversary framings change the chosen option of seven language models on 30 to 77 of 108 items against an exact no-effect rate. Yet, no measurement can determine whether this movement is toward the adversary-aware optimum or toward salience, because the two options are identical. This is a structural limit, not a null result. The diagnostic check is cheap: before evaluating adversary-awareness, verify whether the robust target coincides with a heuristic target on the evaluation items.

</details>


### [299] [Conflicting Supervision Moves Commitment, Not Capability: A 12.29σ arrangement effect that is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic score](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00234)
*Wenhui Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究训练数据中两种"正确但互不相容"的约定（convention）的排序如何写入模型参数，证明学习率调度是决定该排序效应的"平均算子"而非背景条件，并通过控制实验给出可分离的定量测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往仅报告"衰减调度会削弱排序效应"这一现象（如预训练中），但缺乏机制解释、效应分离与受控测量。作者要回答：数据排列顺序究竟向参数写入了什么，以及学习率调度在其中扮演什么角色。

Method: 将同一语料以十种不同排序、固定算力预算、只改变路径进行训练，在仅 lr_scheduler_type 不同的调度族下各跑两遍；在一个统一界中将"排列"（仅以块周期形式）与"调度"（仅以端点对任一时刻的最大权重形式）作为两个相乘的独立因子分离；并用 acc_A+acc_B 的守恒性检验约定无关指标下的切换效应，另以 prompt 中标注约定做对照。

Result: 恒定学习率下内部跨度达 0.2221（分配比例），对比下限 11.63，且随排列分块程度单调变化；在常用的单一 cosine 调度下，同样十条臂仅落在两个可区分状态（本应可分辨约十个）。跨十二条臂 acc_A+acc_B 在 9.7% 内守恒，而分配份额从 0.04 变到 0.87，即 12.29-sigma 的排列切换在约定无关指标下恰为零。在 prompt 中标注约定可将切换收敛，并达到并集上限的 87.5%。

Conclusion: "顺序重要"与"顺序不重要"是同一旋钮的两端：路径写入的是模型对某一约定的承诺，且任何精确匹配基准都无法察觉。衰减调度通过限制端点对单一时刻的权重来抑制排序效应，恒定调度则在最后一步同时施加大步长与未收缩残差，从而放大该效应。

Abstract: "Train a model on the same problems written under two incompatible conventions, both correct, and ask what the ordering of that data writes into the parameters. The learning-rate schedule is not a background condition for that question. It is the averaging operator, and it decides the answer. We prove a bound in which the arrangement and the schedule enter the ordering effect as separate multiplied factors: the arrangement only as a block period, the schedule only as how much weight the endpoint can place on any one moment of the run. A decaying schedule cannot put a large step size and an uncontracted remainder at the same moment; a constant one does exactly that at the last step. That decay moderates ordering effects has been reported in pretraining; the mechanism, the separation, and a controlled measurement of both halves are ours. Ten orderings of one corpus, one budget, everything but the path held fixed, run twice under families differing in lr_scheduler_type and nothing else: at a constant rate the interior spans 0.2221 in allocation, 11.63 contrast floors, monotone in how blocked the arrangement is. Under the single cosine every published arm uses, the same ten arms occupy two distinguishable states where their own resolution would allow about ten. "Order matters" and "order does not matter" are the two ends of one knob. What the path writes is which convention the model commits to, and no exact-match benchmark can see it. Across twelve arms acc_A+acc_B is constant to within 9.7% while the allocation share runs 0.04 to 0.87, so the 12.29-sigma arrangement switch this paper measures is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic metric. That conservation is quoted from the decayed family throughout, the constant-rate one being a noisier place to read it. Marking the convention in the prompt collapses the switch and reaches 87.5% of the union ceiling."

</details>
